raw.description:
About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

Overview

Reporting to the Head of Digital, the Senior Manager, Web will lead Neo4j’s web strategy and execution across a global digital ecosystem. This critical role blends strategic vision with analytical precision and strong stakeholder management to ensure Neo4j’s web presence delivers a cohesive, high-performing experience that advances brand, engagement, and conversion goals.

You will define and drive the web strategy, leveraging data-driven insights and cross-functional collaboration to evolve our website into a dynamic growth engine. The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on, with expertise spanning digital strategy, analytics, UX optimization, and project execution.

Key Responsibilities

Web Strategy & Stakeholder Management

  • Develop and own the overarching web strategy that aligns with Neo4j’s marketing and business goals — encompassing web architecture, navigation, content structure, and UX best practices.
  • Ensure consistency and continuity in design, layout, and messaging across all pages and regions.
  • Conduct competitive analysis to identify emerging digital trends, innovative approaches, and opportunities to enhance our online presence.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Content, Design, Operations, and Regional Marketing to align web priorities with business objectives.
  • Present strategy and results to stakeholders and leadership, using data to articulate rationale, performance, and recommendations.
  • Serve as the key liaison between digital, marketing, and product teams, balancing business needs, brand integrity, and user experience.

Project Management & Execution

  • Lead end-to-end management of web-related projects and initiatives — from intake and planning to execution and launch.
  • Oversee project pipelines, ensuring all stakeholders provide necessary inputs, assets, and approvals.
  • Manage timelines, scope, and deliverables, maintaining transparency through effective communication and project documentation.
  • Ensure alignment across multiple workstreams, tracking progress and proactively resolving blockers.
  • Champion operational excellence within the digital team by optimizing workflows and standardizing processes.

Web Analytics & Performance Optimization

  • Leverage web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Looker, Data Studio) to monitor site performance, engagement, and conversion across key pages and funnels.
  • Analyze user journeys, engagement patterns, and conversion metrics to inform decision-making and continuously optimize the site.
  • Partner with analytics and content teams to establish KPIs for traffic, engagement, and conversion, and report on progress through regular dashboards and presentations.
  • Evaluate page and campaign launches using quantitative (heat maps, click maps, funnel analysis) and qualitative (feedback, session recordings) insights to improve performance over time.
  • Translate findings into actionable recommendations to enhance UX and business impact.

A/B Testing & Optimization Roadmap

  • Develop and execute a test-and-learn agenda focused on improving traffic quality, engagement, and conversion rates.
  • Design and oversee A/B and multivariate testing initiatives — from hypothesis to experiment design, execution, and insights.
  • Partner with analytics and UX to prioritize tests that deliver measurable impact and contribute to a culture of continuous optimization.
  • Document learnings and socialize best practices across teams to inform broader digital and marketing efforts.

Who You Are

  • 7+ years of experience in web, digital marketing, or product management, ideally within a B2B or SaaS environment.
  • Proven ability to develop strategy and lead cross-functional alignment for complex digital ecosystems.
  • Deep understanding of web analytics and performance optimization; fluent in GA4, tag management, dashboards, and conversion tracking.
  • Strong familiarity with A/B testing tools (e.g., Optimizely, Google Optimize, VWO) and SEO/SEM principles.
  • Excellent communicator with the ability to translate data and strategy into clear, persuasive narratives.
  • Highly organized project manager experienced in agile workflows and tools like Asana or Jira.
  • Passionate about staying current with digital, UX, and web technology trends.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action, capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • A cohesive and scalable web strategy implemented across teams.
  • Clear data-driven visibility into performance and ROI of web initiatives.
  • A robust testing and optimization program driving measurable growth in engagement and conversions.
  • Smooth, on-time execution of projects with strong stakeholder alignment and communication.

The annual base salary range for this position based in the United States is listed below. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Neo4j’s compensation practices, job related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and trainings, in addition to geographic location. Based on the factors above, Neo4j utilizes the full width of the range.

In addition to the range below, US employees are eligible for a stock option grant and certain roles are eligible for an annual bonus. Employees in this position are also eligible to participate in the Company’s standard benefit programs, which currently include the following: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k), paid time off, and certain leaves of absence.

Annual Base Salary Range for This Role
$150,000—$185,000 USD

Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

  • Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years.
  • Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
  • 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific, BT Group, Caterpillar, Cisco, Comcast, Department for Education UK, eBay, NBC News, Novo Nordisk, Worldline, and others.
  • Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
  • Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
  • A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.

At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues.

One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career-defining experience. We look forward to receiving your application.

Neo4j is a Silicon Valley company with a Swedish soul. We foster collaboration and each of us is empowered to contribute and put our innovative stamp on projects. We hire candidates who reflect the following Neo4j core values:

about kiron

About Kiron Digital Learning Solutions GmbH

Kiron Digital Learning Solutions (KDLS) is a social business based in Berlin that develops digital learning solutions with a strong focus on diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Working closely with its non-profit partner Kiron Education (NGO), the organisation leverages technology and pedagogical expertise to create inclusive digital learning environments and empower organisations to build more diverse and equitable workplaces.

Since 2015, the Kiron ecosystem has been designing digital learning experiences for highly diverse learner groups, including refugees and underserved communities. Through its consulting, training programmes, and learning platform, Kiron Digital supports organisations in creating impactful and inclusive learning experiences while contributing to broader social change.

As a social business, KDLS reinvests its profits into the mission of the Kiron NGO: expanding access to quality education and fostering equal opportunities worldwide.

about the program:

KDLS hat die Migration Manager Academy (MMA) entwickelt, ein Weiterbildungsprogramm für HR-Fachkräfte, die sich im Bereich der internationalen Personalgewinnung weiterbilden und lernen möchten, wie sie internationale Talente erfolgreich in ihre Belegschaft integrieren.

Die MMA ist ein sechsmonatiges, AZAV-zertifiziertes Blended-Learning-Programm und umfasst Themen rund um internationale Rekrutierung, Einstellung, Migration sowie Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging (DEIB).

Der Kurs kombiniert selbstgesteuerte Lerninhalte mit Live-Sessions. Die Live-Sessions werden vom jeweiligen Facilitator eigenständig gestaltet und durchgeführt.

about the role

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du als Tutor und begleitest die Lernenden während des gesamten 24-wöchigen Programms. Du leitest einmal pro Woche eine 90-minütige Online-Session und setzt dabei interaktive Aktivitäten ein, um die Lernenden bei der Reflexion und Vertiefung der Kursinhalte zu unterstützen. Darüber hinaus übernimmst du die Vorbereitung der Sessions, die laufende Betreuung der Lernenden sowie Aufgaben im Bereich Monitoring und Evaluierung.


Startdatum: Idealerweise im September

Programmdauer: Zunächst 6 Monate

Wöchentlicher Stundenumfang: 5 Stunden

your tasks

  • Vorbereitung der Online-Sitzungen (Learning Design Team hat bereits Vorschläge für Aktivitäten entwickelt, diese können aber durch die Trainer:in angepasst werden; außerdem können visuelle Hilfsmittel entwickelt werden)

  • Leitung der Online-Sitzungen

  • Unterstützung der Lernenden (auch außerhalb der Online-Sitzungen, bspw. durch Beantwortung von Fragen)

  • Monitoring und Evaluierung (hinsichtlich Kursfortschritt, aktiver Teilnahme an Online-Sitzungen)

  • Feedback einholen und mitteilen (sowohl aus Sicht der Lernenden als auch aus der der Trainerin bzw. des Trainers)

your profile

Du hast;

  • Erfahrung in der Moderation, im Unterrichten oder in der Durchführung von Workshops

  • Gutes Verständnis von HR, globalen Rekrutierungsprozessen und rechtlichen Rahmenbedingungen

  • Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit den Themen Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit und Inklusion (DEIB) sowie die Fähigkeit, sich schnell in ein spezialisiertes Curriculum einzuarbeiten

  • Persönliche oder fachliche Erfahrung mit Migration, Fachkräftemangel und Vielfalt am Arbeitsplatz

  • Vertraut mit Online-Tools wie Zoom, Google Drive und Lernplattformen (LMS)

  • Gute Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten

  • Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Deutsch (jeweils mindestens auf C1-Niveau)

Idealerweise bringst du mit;

  • Vertraut mit Online-Tools wie Zoom, Google Drive und Lernplattformen (LMS)

  • Gute Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten

Event Marketing Manager

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic, highly organized Events Manager to lead the planning, execution, and measurement of our global events program. This role goes far beyond logistics. It is responsible for developing event strategies that drive business outcomes, delivering integrated campaigns from concept through post-event analysis, and partnering across the organization to maximize impact.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional project management skills with strong marketing acumen, understands how events fit into an integrated GTM strategy, and is passionate about creating memorable experiences that generate measurable results.

What You'll Do

Event Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive event strategy aligned with company and GTM objectives.
  • Evaluate and prioritize event investments based on business impact, target audience, and ROI.
  • Build annual and quarterly event plans that support pipeline generation, customer engagement, brand awareness, and strategic partnerships.
  • Continuously identify new event opportunities and innovative ways to engage target audiences.

End-to-End Campaign Management

  • Own the complete event lifecycle: from strategy, planning, budgeting, and execution through post-event analysis.
  • Build integrated marketing campaigns around each event in partnership with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Content, Digital Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
  • Define campaign objectives, messaging, target audiences, promotional plans, and success metrics.
  • Ensure every event has a clear pre-event, onsite, and post-event engagement strategy.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the central program manager across Marketing, Sales, Product, Executive Leadership, Operations, Finance, Legal, and external vendors.
  • Align stakeholders on goals, timelines, responsibilities, and deliverables.
  • Manage agency and vendor relationships while ensuring projects stay on time and within budget.
  • Enable internal teams with event plans, briefing materials, messaging, and follow-up processes.

Event Execution & Experience

  • Deliver exceptional onsite experiences that reflect the company's brand and create meaningful customer engagement.
  • Oversee logistics including venue selection, booth design, sponsorship execution, executive speaking opportunities, customer meetings, hospitality, and event operations.
  • Anticipate risks, solve problems proactively, and ensure flawless execution under pressure.

Measurement & Optimization

  • Define KPIs and success metrics for every event.
  • Analyze pipeline contribution, influenced revenue, attendee engagement, meetings, customer outcomes, and overall ROI.
  • Present clear post-event readouts with insights, recommendations, and optimization opportunities.
  • Use data to continuously improve event strategy, campaign performance, and budget allocation.

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience managing B2B marketing events, field marketing, or integrated marketing programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop event strategy, not just execute logistics.
  • Experience managing end-to-end integrated marketing campaigns.
  • Experience managing international events.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Customer Success, Executive Leadership, and Operations.
  • Analytical mindset with experience measuring marketing performance, pipeline impact, and ROI.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

Success in This Role

You'll be successful if you:

  • Think like a marketer, not just an event planner.
  • Connect every event to measurable business outcomes.
  • Build strong partnerships across teams to deliver integrated event experience.
  • Balance strategic thinking with flawless execution.
  • Continuously optimize programs using data and customer insights.
  • Create exceptional experiences that strengthen our brand and accelerate growth.

Backblaze Perks:

  • Healthcare for family, including dental and vision
  • Competitive compensation and 401K
  • RSU grants for full-time employees
  • ESPP program
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Maternity & paternity leave
  • MacBook Pro to use for work plus a generous stipend to personalize your workstation
  • Childcare bonus (human children only)
  • Fertility treatment and support
  • Learning & development program
  • Commuter benefits
  • Culture that supports a healthy work-life balance

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state.   4. Experience sourcing and interpreting regulatory codes and integrating them into technical solutions.

The Opportunity:

This role will support the modernization of MassMutual’s Disability Income underwriting manual, including the evaluation, redesign, development, and ongoing maintenance of evidence-based medical and non-medical underwriting guidelines. This is a high-impact opportunity to contribute to a strategic initiative that will help shape the future of DI underwriting at MassMutual and support the development of next-generation underwriting guidance aligned with digital transformation, underwriting quality, and long-term risk performance.

The ideal candidate will be a highly experienced Disability Income underwriter with strong technical expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to translate complex medical, underwriting, claims, and industry information into clear, practical guidance for underwriters.

The Team:

You’ll join a collaborative and forward-thinking team of underwriters from various backgrounds and product expertise, who are motivated to shape the underwriting landscape at MassMutual. As a team, we demonstrate accountability, agility, a dedication to being inclusive, strong business acumen, and the courage and professionalism to advocate for meaningful change while constructively challenging the status quo.

The Impact:

  • Support the modernization and ongoing evolution of MassMutual’s Disability Income medical and non-medical underwriting manuals, helping ensure guidelines are evidence-based, practical, consistent, and aligned with business objectives.

  • Research medical conditions, treatment advances, clinical outcomes, claims experience, and industry practices to support the development of updated underwriting guidance.

  • Draft, review, and refine medical underwriting guidelines that translate complex clinical and risk information into clear, actionable direction for underwriters.

  • Partner with the DI Head Underwriter, Lead Disability Underwriter, Medical Directors, Claims, Pricing, Compliance, Product, and underwriting leadership to ensure guideline recommendations are balanced, competitive, and appropriately aligned with risk objectives.

  • Contribute to impairment-based underwriting frameworks and support the development of consistent approaches to clinical risk stratification.

  • Support digital and automated underwriting initiatives by helping translate guidelines into rules-based decisioning logic, knowledge-base content, and future underwriting technology requirements.

  • Assist with training, communication, and change management efforts to promote adoption of updated underwriting guidance across underwriting teams.

  • 8+ years of work experience in Individual Disability Income Insurance Underwriting OR 8+ years as an Occupational Health Nurse

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in DI underwriting, including medical risk assessment, underwriting standards interpretation, and underwriting operations.

  • Familiarity with impairment-based underwriting frameworks and clinical risk stratification.

  • Exposure to automated or digital underwriting tools, rules-based decisioning, or underwriting knowledge-base development.

  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to create clear, concise, and actionable technical guidance.

  • Ability to collaborate across functions and influence through expertise, credibility, and sound judgment.

MassMutual offers the opportunity to do meaningful work within a purpose-driven organization that values long-term impact over short-term outcomes. In this role, you can expect:

Clear areas of ownership and accountability, with work that connects directly to company and customer outcomes

About Frontier

Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 150-person company with most of our team based in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints began helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we spun out a new company to focus exclusively on that — and called it Frontier.

At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people and place them into the best companies. In three years, we’ve never lost a client. If you’re interested in a Frontier role and you apply and are accepted, we’ll screen you through assessments and interviews and aim to get you an interview for a full-time job within the month.

Think of us as your personal talent agent — and good luck with the application! 😊

Travel Operations Specialist | Remote | Luxury Account

About Ascend

Ascend helps founders, investors, and executives book international business and first-class flights at rates that are typically 30-80% below what you would find on a regular booking site. We combine smart, proprietary booking methods with round-the-clock personal service delivered over WhatsApp.

We have grown from 12 to 66 people in just over a year, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, and 5x'd our revenue year-over-year. We are at $22M+ ARR and growing fast. Our mission is to make first-class travel accessible to the people who are shaping the world.

Our clients are founders, investors, and senior executives who expect fast, accurate, and polished service. They do not chase confirmations. They trust us to get it right every time.

The Role

We are hiring a Travel Operations Specialist to take a confirmed flight booking and turn it into a complete, polished travel package delivered to the client.

Once a ticket has been issued by the Ticketing team, the booking comes to you. Your job is to build the full itinerary, prepare the invoice, confirm that payment has been received and recorded correctly, and send everything to the client with clarity and warmth. You also coordinate any extras the client needs, such as airport transfers, seat selections, or special meal preferences.

The client has trusted us with a high-value booking. What you send them is the moment they see the result of that trust. Everything needs to be accurate, professional, and exactly what was agreed.

Compensation

$500 - $600/month USD, depending on experience.

Compensation is reviewed based on performance, with clear milestones tied to progression.

What You'll Do

Building and Delivering the Trip

  • Receive each confirmed booking handed over by the Ticketing team and create or update the full trip record in our client management system, including all flight details, passenger information, seat assignments, meal preferences, and frequent flyer numbers
  • Prepare invoices using FreshBooks, our billing platform, following your Team Lead's instructions, and hold them for review before sending anything to the client
  • Once the itinerary and invoice are approved by your Team Lead, send them to the client with a warm, professional message in Periskope, our client communication platform
  • Coordinate any additional services the client has requested, such as airport chauffeur pickups, specific seat selections, or special meals, and record all confirmation details in the client's trip record

Payment Verification

  • Before sending any deliverable to a client, confirm that payment has been received and correctly recorded. You will cross-check payment status across our internal systems using details provided by your Team Lead
  • Payments at Ascend come in several forms: credit card charges processed through Stripe, bank wire transfers, PayPal, and occasionally cryptocurrency. Each has a specific verification process you will follow, and your Team Lead will confirm the status for each before you proceed
  • If the payment record in any system does not match what you expect, flag it to your Team Lead immediately. You do not communicate payment issues directly to the client

Data Accuracy

  • Make sure all records in our client management system and billing platform match before any client communication goes out. This includes passenger details, flight information, invoice amounts, and payment status
  • Keep records updated in real time throughout your shift. If a booking changes, the record changes immediately
  • Ensure no booking task sits unactioned for more than 30 minutes during your shift

Collaboration and Escalation

  • Work closely with your Team Lead, who reviews your work, approves client sends, and is there to support you on anything complex
  • Coordinate with the Ticketing team on any changes that affect a ticket after issuance, and with the Client Service team on any client-facing updates
  • Escalate any payment discrepancy, data mismatch, or client issue to your Team Lead immediately rather than trying to resolve it alone

What You Bring

Must Have

  • 1-2+ years in travel operations, hospitality administration, client coordination, or a similar role where managing detailed records across multiple systems was a core part of your work
  • Experience creating or managing invoices using a billing tool such as FreshBooks, QuickBooks, or similar platforms
  • Familiarity with verifying or reconciling payments across different methods, whether card, bank transfer, or digital payment platforms
  • Strong attention to accuracy across multiple tools at the same time: you notice when something does not match, and you investigate rather than ignore it
  • Clear, professional written communication: you can write a warm, polished client message without needing a template for every situation
  • The ability to manage several tasks at once without losing track of the details, especially during busy shift periods

Administrative and Reception Support

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, professional, and dependable Virtual Medical Assistant to support a chiropractic clinic. This position will focus primarily on reception, patient communication, scheduling coordination, documentation, and administrative support.

You will serve as a key point of contact for patients and work closely with a small, collaborative clinic team. The ideal candidate communicates confidently over the phone, manages multiple responsibilities efficiently, and remains calm and solution-focused when handling urgent or emotional patient concerns.

Key Responsibilities

1. Reception and Patient Communication

  • Handle inbound and outbound calls through the clinic's VoIP system, screen routine inquiries, assist patients, and route urgent concerns to the appropriate team member.

  • Monitor text messages, platform chats, and voicemails, respond to basic questions, coordinate appointment requests, and prioritize messages requiring immediate action.

  • Provide a professional and welcoming patient experience while managing multiple communication channels and supporting the clinic's daily workflow.

2. Scheduling and Care Plan Tracking

  • Coordinate appointments, address scheduling requests, and ensure updates are accurately communicated to patients and the in-office team.

  • Track each patient's progress from the initial evaluation through care plan presentation, acceptance, and follow-up using project management and clinic systems.

  • Enter care plan information, checklists, timestamps, and reminders into the electronic medical record system to ensure timely follow-up.

3. Documentation and Intake Support

  • Pre-populate reassessment forms using existing patient information so documents are ready before the patient arrives.

  • Review new patient onboarding requirements and confirm that intake paperwork is completed before the scheduled appointment.

  • Follow up with patients regarding incomplete forms and maintain accurate, organized, and confidential documentation.

4. Future Administrative and Marketing Support

  • Communicate with attorneys by phone or email to follow up on patient cases and personal injury documentation when required.

  • Monitor and organize leads generated through SEO campaigns and external digital marketing platforms.

  • Contact prospective patients through calls or messages, answer basic questions, and help convert qualified leads into scheduled appointments.

Work Schedule

This position follows a split-shift schedule designed to align with the clinic's operating hours.

Day

Working Hours in Eastern Time

Monday and Tuesday

9:00 AM to 1:30 PM and 2:45 PM to 6:45 PM

Wednesday

7:00 AM to 1:00 PM

Thursday

2:30 PM to 7:00 PM

Friday to Sunday

Flexible 2.5 hours total for brief check-ins and outstanding appointment requests

Candidates must be comfortable with the split-shift arrangement and available to consistently work during the required Eastern Time hours.

Mandatory Qualifications

  • At least one year of experience supporting a U.S.-based medical, wellness, or administrative clinic.

  • Advanced or near-native English verbal and written communication skills, with clear and professional phone communication.

  • Strong comprehension, active listening, multitasking, organization, and attention to detail.

Professional Skills

  • Ability to remain calm, grounded, and solution-oriented when assisting emotional, frustrated, or urgent patients.

  • Confidence managing phone calls, messages, appointment requests, paperwork, and administrative tasks simultaneously.

  • Ability to work independently, follow established workflows, protect patient confidentiality, and communicate proactively with a remote team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience working with a chiropractic office, wellness facility, or similar healthcare practice.

  • Familiarity with legal, attorney, personal injury, or patient case documentation.

  • Experience following up with marketing leads and converting prospective patients into scheduled appointments.

Tools and Platforms

Experience with all platforms is not required, but familiarity with healthcare, communication, and project management software is highly preferred.

  • Platinum System: Electronic medical records and patient care plan documentation

  • Sked: Patient text messaging and appointment management

  • Monday.com: Internal tracking, business statistics, metrics, and workflows

  • IntakeQ: Digital patient onboarding and intake paperwork

  • Vonage: Inbound and outbound phone communication

  • Google Docs and Google Sheets: Documentation, tracking, and collaborative administrative work

  • GoHighLevel: Future marketing lead and campaign management

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is polished, patient-focused, resourceful, and highly dependable. You should be comfortable taking ownership of administrative responsibilities, communicating with patients throughout the day, and keeping information organized across several platforms.

This role is best suited for someone who enjoys supporting a small healthcare team, improving workflows, and helping create a smooth and welcoming experience for every patient.

Job Description:
The primary purpose of this position is to manage, maintain, implement, and improve cloud-focused, platform-agnostic IT infrastructure environments supporting Government customers and regulated workloads. This position focuses on secure cloud, hybrid cloud, and multi-cloud environments, including Microsoft Azure Government/GCC High and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS) GovCloud, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Supported environments will include multi-cloud platforms; compute, storage, networking, security, identity, observability, automation, backup, database, and service management capabilities; and customer or hosted data center environments. This position ensures high levels of availability, security, performance, compliance, and operational stability for supported Government systems and business applications. The ideal candidate will have advanced technical expertise across multiple cloud platforms, the ability to design and operate secure Government cloud environments, experience applying compliance frameworks and security controls, and the ability to support mission-critical customer environments through participation in a 24x7 on-call rotation.

What You Will Do:

  • Provide operational support, administration, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management for Government customer cloud and hybrid infrastructure environments across Azure Government/GCC High, AWS GovCloud, and/or GCP.
  • Monitor, maintain, and optimize customer cloud environments to ensure availability, performance, security, compliance, and adherence to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Perform incident, problem, change, and request management activities following established ITIL, security, compliance, and operational processes.
  • Respond to and resolve customer incidents, service requests, alerts, and operational issues across cloud compute, storage, networking, identity, security, automation, monitoring, backup, and platform services.
  • Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation supporting critical Government customer environments, including after-hours, weekends, holidays as required.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and remediation of complex cloud and infrastructure issues while driving preventative actions to improve reliability.
  • Support secure cloud operations by applying Government compliance requirements and security frameworks, including FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, DISA STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, and other applicable standards.
  • Manage and maintain cloud configurations, access controls, security controls, monitoring, logging, automation, and operational documentation.
  • Implement approved changes, upgrades, patches, migrations, and configuration updates while following established change management processes.
  • Develop and maintain automation, Infrastructure as Code, scripts, runbooks, knowledge articles, and operational procedures to improve efficiency and consistency.
  • Perform capacity management, performance analysis, health assessments, and proactive remediation activities to improve customer environments.
  • Provide technical guidance and recommendations to improve cloud architecture, operational maturity, security posture, automation, and service delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate effectively with customers, account teams, project managers, and internal stakeholders regarding incidents, changes, risks, technical issues, and service performance.
  • Maintain accurate service documentation, incident records, change records, knowledge articles, and customer environment documentation.
  • Participate in customer service reviews, technical discussions, and operational meetings to support customer satisfaction and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Professional Services, Security, Architecture, Sales, and Operations teams to deliver high-quality Managed Services outcomes.
  • Support pre-sales activities by providing technical expertise, solution recommendations, and input into cloud Managed Services opportunities.
  • Research, evaluate, and recommend cloud technologies, automation capabilities, security solutions, and operational improvements that enhance Managed Services offerings.
  • Mentor and support team members by sharing technical knowledge, operational best practices, and cloud engineering expertise.

What We Expect of You:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of IT infrastructure engineering experience, including cloud, platform, systems, network, automation, or operations engineering experience, OR 9 total years of IT engineering experience, including 5 years of relevant infrastructure or cloud engineering experience.
  • IT engineering experience with one or more infrastructure or cloud solutions supported by the Managed Services practice, including cloud platforms, enterprise storage, Windows and/or Unix/Linux systems, virtualization, observability, automation, databases, security tools, and service management platforms.
  • Advanced-level technical certifications in at least two of the following three cloud platforms: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience designing, implementing, and supporting cloud solutions across one or more of the following platforms: Microsoft Azure Government / Azure GCC High; AWS GovCloud (US); Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Ability and drive to further technical education through achieving certification and training plans specific to relevant cloud, infrastructure, automation, security, or service management technologies.
  • Ability to establish customer trust and confidence in CDW Managed Services knowledge of and concern for customers’ business needs.
  • Experience applying Government and industry compliance frameworks, including FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, FISMA, DISA STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, or comparable security standards.
  • History of balancing multiple priorities simultaneously with the ability to adapt to changing customer needs while meeting deadlines.
  • Ability to perform advanced root cause analysis.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Customer-service focused with a high level of professionalism.
  • Ability to consistently follow policies and procedures.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with coworkers and stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Ability to prioritize work and handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced, diverse, growth-oriented environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and be self-sufficient.
  • Ability to work as a team and provide guidance, mentorship, and support of peers.

  • Ability to understand, remember, and apply oral and/or written instructions or other information.

  • 3 years of Managed Services experience is a plus.
  • Cloud, automation, security, ITIL, networking, infrastructure, or platform certifications, is a plus.

raw.description:
Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

This role sits on one of the largest database estates in the world, supporting one of our biggest clients — the kind of scale most infrastructure engineers never get direct access to. Changes made here don't touch one system, they touch a fleet, so the impact of good (and bad) engineering is outsized.

We're looking for an infrastructure/DevOps engineer to own the AWS platform our clients' RDS and Aurora databases run on — not the databases' internals. You'll manage the Terraform and CI/CD pipeline (GitLab, Harness) that provisions them, maintain the supporting tooling that handles user and schema management, and be the escalation point when a team's Terraform, pipeline, or process has gone wrong. A big part of the job is making that go wrong less often: improving documentation, and building out the tooling that automatically routes support queries to the right place instead of everything landing on-call.

If this is you, and you wonder what it would be like to work at Pythian, reach out to us and find out!

Intrigued to see what a life is like at Pythian? Check out #pythianlife on LinkedIn and follow @loveyourdata on Instagram!

Not the right job for you? Check out what other great jobs Pythian has open around the world! Pythian Careers

What you will be doing:

Support & Troubleshooting:

Act as the escalation point when clients or internal teams break their Terraform, break their pipeline, or don't follow documented process — diagnose the actual problem and get them unblocked.

Write clear Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports for significant incidents.

Infrastructure & Automation:

Build and maintain Terraform for provisioning AWS database infrastructure (RDS/Aurora), and the GitLab/Harness pipelines that deploy it.

Maintain the supporting tooling that manages database users and schemas, ensuring it stays correctly integrated with the databases it manages.

Automate recurring operational work with Python or Go.

Apply AWS security best practices — IAM roles, KMS encryption, Security Groups, Network ACLs — across managed environments.

Enablement & Tooling:

Build and improve the incident-response tooling so support queries get automatically routed to the right place, rather than landing on the person who is on call.

Own and improve documentation — runbooks, operational guides, disaster recovery procedures — so people stop making the same mistakes.

What we need from you:

  • 5+ Years of experience with AWS and Terraform in a production environment
  • Provisioning AWS infrastructure through a CI/CD pipeline (GitLab, Github, Harness, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with RDS/Aurora operations — backup/restore, replication, disaster recovery — at the infrastructure level
  • Solid understanding of AWS security and compliance controls.
  • Experience automating operational tasks with Python or Go.
  • Proficiency in AWS networking (VPC, Subnets, Transit Gateways).
  • Comfortable being the person people come to when infrastructure or a pipeline is broken — clear communication under pressure, no hand-holding needed to trace a symptom to its root cause.
  • Nice to have: Docker, Vault, ProxySQL, and general relational database familiarity (MySQL or similar).

What you will receive:

  • Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity.
  • Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
  • Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
  • Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!
  • Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!
  • Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favorite charity.

HiringDisclaimer

  • The successful applicant will need to fulfill the requirements necessary to obtain a background check.
  • Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in any aspect of the selection process.

AI Disclaimer

Pythian may utilize Enterprise Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools or features throughout its hiring process. These tools help us manage high volumes of applications efficiently and may be employed to review applications, analyze resumes, and assist with other recruitment steps. While Pythian uses AI in its hiring process, it does not substitute for human judgment. Our Talent Acquisition Team reviews all AI-generated recommendations, and the system is subject to regular bias audits to ensure fairness and compliance with all applicable employment and human rights laws. All final hiring decisions are made by, and remain the responsibility of, human decision-makers. By applying for this position, you consent to Pythian’s use of these AI tools in the evaluation of your application. You have the right to request a human review of any solely AI-driven decision or to request an accommodation. Should you require further details regarding the processing of your data, please reach out to us.

raw.description:
Quality Assurance Engineer (Manual + Automation | SaaS) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (flexibility for releases and sprints)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Quality Assurance Engineer (QA Tester) to ensure software products are thoroughly tested, reliable, and production-ready before release.

This is a hands-on QA role combining manual testing, test automation, defect management, API testing, and close collaboration with engineering teams.

You’ll act as a critical quality gate throughout the software development lifecycle — identifying bugs, validating fixes, testing edge cases, and helping prevent issues from reaching production.

If you naturally look for what could break, think through edge cases, and care deeply about delivering reliable software, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Test Planning & Coverage

  • Create and maintain:
    • Test plans
    • Test cases
    • Test scenarios
    • Acceptance criteria
  • Define appropriate test coverage across new features, integrations, and regression flows.
  • Review requirements and identify potential gaps or risks before development is completed.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to ensure requirements are testable and clearly understood.

Manual Testing – Core Responsibility

  • Execute:
    • Functional testing
    • Regression testing
    • Integration testing
    • UI/UX validation
    • Cross-browser testing
    • Cross-device testing
  • Identify bugs, inconsistencies, and edge cases before release.
  • Log and manage defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Provide developers with clear:
    • Reproduction steps
    • Expected vs. actual behavior
    • Screenshots or recordings
    • Environment details
  • Retest fixes and perform regression testing on impacted functionality.

Automation Testing

  • Build, maintain, and improve automated test scripts using tools such as:
    • Selenium
    • Cypress
    • Playwright
  • Automate repetitive and high-value regression scenarios.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD workflows using:
    • GitHub Actions
    • Jenkins
    • GitLab CI
  • Investigate failed automated tests and distinguish product defects from test-script issues.

API & Performance Testing

  • Test APIs and backend functionality using Postman or similar tools.
  • Validate:
    • API responses
    • Status codes
    • Data integrity
    • Error handling
    • Integration behavior
  • Conduct performance, load, and stress testing using tools such as:
    • Apache JMeter
    • Locust
  • Support security and vulnerability testing where required.

Defect Tracking & Release Validation

  • Track bugs from discovery through resolution.
  • Prioritize issues based on severity, impact, and release risk.
  • Validate builds before production deployment.
  • Conduct regression and release-readiness testing.
  • Clearly communicate critical defects and potential release risks to stakeholders.

Documentation & Quality Reporting

  • Maintain organized documentation for:
    • Test plans
    • Test cases
    • Test results
    • Defects
    • Regression suites
  • Track quality metrics including:
    • Defect density
    • Test coverage
    • Pass/fail rates
    • Production defects
  • Provide stakeholders with clear visibility into product quality and release readiness.

Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with developers to reproduce and investigate defects.
  • Participate in:
    • Sprint planning
    • Daily standups
    • Retrospectives
    • Release discussions
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams throughout the SDLC.
  • Advocate for quality without unnecessarily slowing down delivery.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely succeed in this role if you:

  • Naturally identify edge cases others overlook.
  • Write clear, structured, and repeatable test cases.
  • Are methodical without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Can clearly explain technical issues to developers.
  • Understand when automation adds value and when manual testing is more effective.
  • Take ownership of bugs through validation and resolution.
  • Care about the overall user experience, not simply whether a test passes.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional QA or software testing experience.
  • Strong hands-on manual testing experience.
  • Experience with functional and regression testing.
  • Experience documenting and tracking defects using Jira or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with test management platforms such as:
    • TestRail
    • Zephyr
  • Familiarity with at least one automation framework:
    • Selenium
    • Cypress
    • Playwright
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
    • Agile development
    • QA methodologies
    • Defect lifecycle management
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Clear written and verbal English communication.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing SaaS or enterprise software products.
  • Strong API testing experience using Postman or RestAssured.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with performance testing using JMeter or Locust.
  • Exposure to security or vulnerability testing.
  • Experience working within compliance-heavy software environments.
  • Familiarity with Git and modern engineering workflows.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may start by reviewing new requirements and writing test cases for an upcoming feature. You’ll execute manual tests, run regression suites, investigate failed automated tests, and document any defects you uncover.

Throughout the day, you’ll work directly with developers to reproduce issues, validate fixes, test APIs or integrations, and assess whether builds are ready for release.

In short: you find and help resolve problems before customers encounter them.

Key Metrics for Success

  • High percentage of defects caught before production.
  • Strong regression test coverage.
  • Low number of critical production defects.
  • Fast and accurate defect validation.
  • Reliable automated test suites.

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel FSP is looking to hire multiple Global Study Managers in Argentina, Brazil or Mexico!

Job Summary

The Global Study Manager II (GSM II) provides operational leadership throughout the study lifecycle, with accountability for oversight and execution of study management, site management, preferred Contract Research Organization (pCRO), and vendor deliverables for all study management deliverables in a study.

The Global Study Manager has exceptional knowledge within the organization for Study Management processes and deliverables. Additionally, the Global Study Manager will maintain expertise within their assigned Therapeutic Area and study in order to set the appropriate strategy, identify risks and to drive operational deliverables. The Global Study Manager will have good knowledge in understanding the responsibilities beyond their function in order to ensure goals are met for the study.

Key Accountabilities:

Study Management Oversight

  • Leads and coordinates the execution of a clinical trial globally from sourcing strategy and study specification development for requests for proposals to fully outsourced studies and ancillary vendors, study start up through database release and inspection readiness to ensure timely delivery of quality study data. May also provide input to and support compilation of sections to clinical study reports (CSRs) as needed

  • Provides quality oversight and coordination of regional and country operations and the pCRO for the tasks both owned by and delegated to Study Operational Managers (SOMs), if assigned to study, related to study execution

  • Provides leadership to the teams in setting recruitment targets and delivery milestones as the single point of accountability for detailed study start up, monitoring, and other study level plans and delivery to the agreed plans by partnering with cross functional colleagues

  • Serves as a critical member of the core team and represents the operational sub-team including applicable vendors and pCRO on matters of study execution

  • Drives decision making and works closely with the Clinical Study Team Lead (CSTL) to provide input to operational strategy

  • Provides supervision and/or mentorship to SOMs and possibly other GSMs

  • Ensures development of study level plans, including the study monitoring and study training plans

  • Develops, reviews, or approves the study startup, study monitoring, protocol recruitment, and training plans and other documents, guidelines, and plans. May delegate development of plans or components of plans to SOMs (if assigned) or to Clinical Study Team Assistants (CSTAs) as appropriate

  • Approves and oversees drug supply management, manages flow of drug supply to the sites, and sets up interactive randomization systems with supply chain lead

  • Ensures overall vendor oversight for vendors managed by SOMs (if assigned), action escalations related to vendor issues and escalate further as necessary

  • Reviews consolidated pre-trial assessment (PTA) reports and feasibility outputs in partnership with appropriate cross functional colleagues

  • Ensures applicable system closure at study completion

  • May support study level submission readiness

  • May participate in vendor user accountability testing (UAT) and system setup requirements review and approval [e.g., Interactive Response Technology (IRT), central lab]

Study Management Operations

  • Accountable for study management and oversight of all study management functions

  • Forms, oversees, and leads the operational sub team and requests resources as needed

  • Ensures the development of realistic detailed study startup and/or study management strategies and monitoring plans, including sourcing strategy, input into requests for proposals, and for the selection of vendors

  • Ensures country level feasibility is completed in collaboration with cross functional departmental colleagues, organizations, and pCRO, reviewing PTA report outputs, approving sites, and assessing site activation plans

  • Ensures Trial Master File (TMF) setup for study management and country and site level documents

  • Provides input into the risk planning process for the study

  • Coordinates development of study and protocol training and global investigator meetings (IMs)

  • Ensures that local IMs are coordinated by the SOM, if assigned to study

  • Develops and provides key inputs to clinical trial budget (e.g., per subject costs)

  • Ensures that SOMs are inputting into the budget for local/country level tasks (if assigned), and reviews cost variance, invoices, and purchase orders (POs) in a timely manner to ensure that spend is appropriate and on track with the forecast

  • Monitors the budget and contracts for assigned vendors [e.g., central labs, electronic patient reported outcomes (ePRO), radiology, pCRO]

  • Accountable for the delivery of the study against approved plans

  • Works directly with cross-functional and department lines and pCRO to resolve or triage site level issues

  • Leads inspection readiness activities related to study management and site readiness

  • Supports development and delivery of decentralized capabilities at investigator sites

  • Ensures timely study closure and release of internal and external resources as appropriate if assigned to study post database lock

  • Monitors vendor contracts for out of scope activities and budget spend and invoices for assigned vendors (e.g., central labs, ePRO, radiology)

  • Reviews study level metrics and analytics and ensures appropriate actions are taken to mitigate risks and resolve issues

  • Works independently and demonstrates resourcefulness

  • May, on occasion, take on the role and responsibilities of a SOM

Study Team Interface

  • Leads and oversees all elements of study startup and monitoring functions to ensure delivery and compliance with all applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and quality standards, interfacing directly with CRO feasibility and study startup, monitoring and management, and site contracting groups

  • Works proactively with data management functions and department colleagues to ensure alignment on data flow and timely delivery

  • Regularly reviews data reports and dashboards to identify risks and drive appropriate actions

  • Shares and escalates plan deviations to CSTL and study team and drives and oversees mitigations

  • Review vendor expenses and workorders as per study budget for assigned vendors (e.g., central labs, ePRO, radiology, pCRO)

  • Provides ongoing assessment of subject enrollment and discontinuations to inform accurate forecasting for financial planning

  • Provides operational input into protocol design

  • Leads protocol deviation trend review, partnering with the clinical team

  • May lead and facilitate the routine study management vendor calls

Subject Matter Expertise

  • Serves as technical expert for study management systems and processes

  • Champions the implementation and use of harmonized, consistent processes, and excellence in study management deliverables related to cost and effective, timely, and high quality clinical trial data according to agreed global goals

  • Provides technical oversight of the operational sub team to include but is not limited to standards, continuous improvement, issue escalation and resolution, inspection readiness and quality assurance, performance feedback, review of metrics

  • Partners with the operational sub team and pCRO to proactively identify and resolve study operations staff performance issues

  • May serve as a resource to the study team in addition to the SOM(s), if assigned, to facilitate project specific audits and inspections

Compliance with Parexel standards

  • Complies with required training curriculum

  • Completes timesheets accurately as required

  • Submits expense reports as required

  • Updates CV as required

  • Maintains a working knowledge of and complies with Parexel processes, ICH-GCPs and other applicable requirements

Skills:

  • Requires exceptional knowledge of own discipline and advanced knowledge of others and applies these skills to ensure a sub-business unit/sub-operating unit meets its goals

  • Creates an environment where innovation is standard, taking appropriate risks to advance innovative processes

  • Develops ideas and leads complex projects across sub-business unit/sub-operating unit

  • Develops innovative solutions to complex problems impacting a sub-business unit/sub-operating unit

  • Exercises own judgment and is a resource for others

  • Acts independently on self-initiated projects

  • Experience in clinical research and/or study management

  • Study management/leadership experience

  • undefined

  • Experience with oversight of CROs and vendors

  • Experience in managing per subject costs, vendor and ancillary and monitoring costs projections and spend Fluency in written and spoken English required

  • Ability to work outside of core business hours, as required, to support global trials or initiatives

  • Ability to travel, as required, including IMs, vendor kick off and re-set meetings, and client internal global or department level meetings

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Exceptional knowledge of study management processes and deliverables

  • Good knowledge in understanding the responsibilities beyond their function to ensure goals are met for the study

  • Maintains expertise within the assigned therapeutic area and study to set the appropriate strategy, identify risks and to drive operational deliverables

  • Working knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), monitoring, clinical and regulatory operations

Education:

  • Bachelor’s of Science or Bachelor’s of Arts degree with a minimum 7 years of relevant operational clinical trial experience required

  • Master’s of Science or Master’s of Business Administration degree with a minimum 6 years of relevant operational clinical trial experience required

  • A scientific or technical degree is preferred along with extensive knowledge of clinical trial methodology

raw.description:
Sagility combines industry-leading technology and transformation-driven BPM services with decades of healthcare domain expertise to help clients draw closer to their members. The company optimizes the entire member/patient experience through service offerings for clinical, case management, member engagement, provider solutions, payment integrity, claims cost containment, and analytics. Sagility has more than 25,000 employees across 5 countries.

The Clinical Operations Supervisor / Team Lead will provide frontline leadership for Registered Nurses supporting the Specialty Pharmacy Initial Clinical Engagement Program. This role is responsible for leading day-to-day clinical operations, supporting nurse performance, ensuring workflow adherence, reinforcing quality and compliance expectations, and helping the team deliver a high-quality patient and caregiver experience.
The program is focused on outreach to patients at the start of a new specialty therapy, including enrollment support, clinical assessments, therapy education, response to patient inquiries, and referral to additional resources as directed by workflow. The frontline nurse role includes telephonic patient and caregiver education, clinical assessments, documentation, adverse event identification and escalation, physician outreach when clinically necessary, and adherence to quality and production standards.
The Team Lead will serve as the first level of operational and clinical support for nurses, helping to drive productivity, quality, documentation accuracy, adherence, attendance, engagement, and compliance. This position will also support onboarding, training, nesting, precepting, coaching, calibration, quality reviews, and operational readiness as the program scales.

Job title:

Clinical Operations Supervisor

Job Description:

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

  • Oversee day-to-day performance and workflow execution for a team of telephonic Registered Nurses supporting the Specialty Pharmacy program.
  • Provide real-time guidance to nurses related to workflows, documentation expectations, patient interactions, systems navigation, escalation pathways, and operational processes.
  • Monitor daily productivity, attendance, adherence, quality outcomes, service levels, queue performance, and other operational metrics.
  • Ensure team readiness at the start of shift, including system access, connectivity, schedule adherence, and issue escalation.
  • Support workload management, staffing coverage, queue awareness, and daily operational stability.
  • Identify operational risks, workflow barriers, training gaps, and performance trends, then partner with Operations leadership to implement corrective actions.
  • Support program ramp readiness, including onboarding, nesting, production transition, and stabilization activities.
  • Assist with client requests, audit readiness, reporting needs, and operational documentation as required.

Performance Management and Coaching

  • Monitor individual and team performance using dashboards, reports, quality findings, attendance data, and operational tools.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one coaching focused on productivity, call handling, documentation accuracy, workflow adherence, quality, compliance, attendance, and patient experience.
  • Complete coaching documentation and maintain accurate performance records.
  • Develop and track action plans for nurses requiring additional support.
  • Support performance improvement plans, corrective action documentation, attendance management, and escalation processes when needed.
  • Recognize strong performance and promote employee engagement, retention, and team morale.
  • Reinforce best practices through team huddles, side-by-side support, refresher coaching, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Clinical Quality, Compliance, and Patient Experience

  • Reinforce adherence to clinical workflows, call handling expectations, documentation standards, escalation requirements, and approved patient education resources.
  • Support accurate completion of clinical assessments, patient education, documentation, and patient/caregiver follow-up in accordance with program requirements.
  • Ensure nurses follow internal processes for adverse event identification, notification, and management within the nursing scope of practice.
  • Support timely escalation of clinical concerns, medication adherence issues, new or unreported symptoms, and other health-related matters identified during the clinical assessment.
  • Partner with Quality, Training, Compliance, and Operations leadership to identify trends, close gaps, and drive improvement.
  • Participate in quality calibration sessions, call listening reviews, documentation audits, performance scorecard reviews, and audit-the-auditor activities.
  • Reinforce compliance with company, client, state, federal, FDA, pharmaceutical, HIPAA, and nursing scope of practice requirements.

Training, Onboarding, and Production Readiness

  • Support new hire training, onboarding, nesting, precepting, workflow reinforcement, and transition to independent production.
  • Partner with Training and Operations leadership to train or reinforce curriculum objectives and ensure nurses are prepared for live patient interaction.
  • Assist with readiness validation, documentation review, call monitoring, chart review follow-up, and targeted coaching.
  • Provide daily feedback during supervised execution and early production transition.
  • Support refresher training, process updates, remediation training, and ongoing program stabilization.
  • May occasionally serve as an interim trainer, facilitator, preceptor, mentor, or Subject Matter Expert for new hire classes, refresher training sessions, process updates, remediation training, and operational readiness activities.

Communication and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a primary liaison between frontline nurses and Operations leadership.
  • Cascade workflow changes, client updates, compliance expectations, quality feedback, and operational announcements.
  • Partner with Workforce Management, Quality, Training, Compliance, HR, IT, Recruiting, Business Excellence, and Operations teams.
  • Participate in leadership meetings, readiness reviews, calibration sessions, governance discussions, and client-facing discussions as needed.
  • Escalate risks, performance concerns, staffing issues, system barriers, access issues, and workflow challenges in a timely and professional manner.
  • Promote alignment across teams to ensure consistent execution, communication, and performance expectations.

Administrative Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation, including coaching logs, huddle notes, action plans, performance summaries, attendance tracking, quality follow-up, and corrective action documentation.
  • Support completion of team-level reporting, operational trackers, readiness documentation, quality follow-up, and client-related requests.
  • Ensure records are organized, audit-ready, and aligned with program expectations.
  • Complete assigned administrative tasks and deliverables within required timelines.

Required Qualifications

Education and Licensure

  • Active, unrestricted U.S. Registered Nurse license required.
  • RN license must be in good standing.
  • Must have an active unencumbered license in the state of residence.
  • Must be eligible to apply for or hold a compact license, as well as additional single-state licenses as program needs require.

Experience

  • Minimum three years of clinical experience as a Registered Nurse preferred.
  • Minimum one year of leadership, mentoring, coaching, precepting, Team Lead, Charge Nurse, Trainer, SME, or supervisory experience preferred.
  • Experience in specialty pharmacy, telephonic nursing, clinical operations, case management, care management, disease management, utilization management, patient education, or healthcare contact center operations preferred.
  • Experience supporting remote, hybrid, or geographically dispersed teams preferred.
  • Experience with new hire training, precepting, peer-to-peer documentation review, or clinical coaching preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies

Leadership and People Management

  • Strong coaching, mentoring, employee development, and performance management skills.
  • Ability to lead difficult conversations with professionalism, consistency, and accountability.
  • Ability to support employee engagement, retention, team morale, and performance improvement.
  • Ability to develop future mentors, SMEs, trainers, and team leaders.

Clinical and Operational Excellence

  • Strong understanding of telephonic clinical workflows, patient education, clinical documentation, quality expectations, and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to support patient-centered interactions while reinforcing approved protocols and nursing scope of practice.
  • Knowledge of productivity, quality, attendance, adherence, service level, and workforce management principles.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving clinical operations environment.

Analytical and Problem Solving

  • Ability to review performance trends, identify root causes, assess risks, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Ability to use dashboards, reports, quality findings, and operational data to support decision-making.
  • Ability to identify workflow gaps, training needs, documentation issues, and compliance risks.

Communication and Collaboration

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong ability to communicate expectations clearly to frontline nurses.
  • Ability to collaborate with peers, leadership, client partners, Quality, Training, Compliance, HR, Workforce, and IT.
  • Ability to escalate concerns timely and professionally.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, reporting tools, workforce management applications, operational dashboards, and healthcare systems.
  • Ability to learn and navigate multiple clinical, documentation, pharmacy, and client platforms.
  • Strong computer skills with the ability to multitask between multiple applications while supporting frontline operations.

Preferred Clinical Background

Preferred clinical experience may include one or more of the following specialty areas:

  • Neurology / Multiple Sclerosis
  • Rheumatology
  • Dermatology
  • Pulmonology
  • Gastroenterology
  • Infectious Disease
  • Asthma
  • Oncology
  • Pediatrics
  • Specialty pharmacy or complex medication therapy support

Success in This Role Means

Success in this role means the Team Lead consistently:

  • Builds and supports a high-performing team of telephonic Registered Nurses.
  • Drives quality, productivity, adherence, documentation accuracy, and patient experience outcomes.
  • Reinforces clinical workflow adherence, patient education standards, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
  • Supports successful onboarding, nesting, competency validation, and transition to independent production.
  • Identifies performance trends and provides timely coaching and action planning.
  • Escalates risks early and helps maintain operational stability during ramp and growth.
  • Partners effectively with Training, Quality, Compliance, Workforce, HR, IT, Recruiting, and Operations leadership.
  • Supports program scalability while maintaining strong clinical quality, compliance, and patient-centered service.

The above statements are intended to indicate the general nature and level of work being performed by employees within this classification.They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this job.Employees in this job may perform other duties as assigned

raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

The P2P Search team is building a next-gen stack for resilient, decentralized search. We're serious about decentralization -- that means a truly peer-to-peer architecture with no centralized index. It's search without servers -- our technology empowers anyone to spin up a self-organizing, unstoppable search engine for text, pics, chats, locations, or any data you can imagine.

Requirements

We're seeking talented software engineers with a passion for P2P, an interest in research but a bias for building, and a deep understanding of some combination of the following:

  • Kademlia DHT.

  • Distributed indexing and the relevant research literature: skip graphs, prefix hash trees, m-LIGHT, locality sensitive hashing.

  • Distributed databases and CRDTs.

  • Networking for P2P: TCP/IP, transport-layer connection orientation and reliability models, multiplexing, NAT traversal, encryption.

  • Classical IR topics and search engine architecture: recall vs. precision, ranking algorithms, lexical vs. semantic search, inverted indices, etc.

  • Network protocol testing, evaluation, and optimization.

  • Writing high performance, highly concurrent networking code.

  • The Holepunch stack: hyperdht, hyperswarm, hypercore, hyperbee, hyperdrive, udx-native
