raw.description:
Thrive is a leading behavior change technology company founded by Arianna Huffington in 2016 with the mission to end the stress and burnout epidemic. Thrive helps individuals and organizations improve well-being, performance and mental resilience with its AI-powered behavior change technology platform. Thrive’s Microsteps – small, science-backed steps to improve health and productivity – have been adopted by employees at more than 125 organizations in over 140 countries, from frontline and call center workers to executives at multinational companies.

If you’re not sure that you’re 100% qualified, but this sounds like a role you would Thrive in – we want you to apply! We believe skills are transferable and passion for our mission goes a long way.

This Principal CSM role sits at the center of one of Thrive's largest and most strategically important health/pharma partnerships. A key priority of this role will be executing against complex deliverables and managing cross-functional stakeholders (both at internal and external.) What distinguishes this role is scope: you will also take on work beyond typical CSM territory — communications plans, activation timelines, program management, and executive-facing roadmaps — often starting from a high-level directive rather than an established template, in close collaboration with our executive leadership team.

You are, first and foremost, an experienced Customer Success professional: diligent, detail-oriented, and fluent in account management. The communications-adjacent work builds on that foundation; it does not replace it. This is a senior, high-trust individual contributor role reporting directly to the VP of Revenue & Customer Success, reflecting both the scale of the account and the degree of executive exposure the role carries.

How You'll Contribute

  • Own the account relationship end to end. Serve as the primary Customer Success owner for a large, strategically critical health/pharma account — confidently managing senior client stakeholders and keeping every workstream on track.
  • Own high-ambiguity strategic deliverables end to end. Independently produce communications plans, program management, campaign timelines, and executive-facing roadmaps for complex, high-visibility client programs — often starting from a high-level directive rather than a defined template. Work product should arrive nearly finished, requiring refinement rather than a rebuild.
  • Partner closely with executive leadership. Take ownership of first-draft materials — communications plans, briefing documents, and activation content — that executive leadership reviews and finalizes. Deep communications expertise is not required, but fluency in communications concepts and terminology is essential.
  • Lead renewal and expansion strategy. Own renewal and expansion planning with minimal oversight, partnering closely with Sales and Leadership. Forecast with accuracy and strategic foresight for a high-value, complex account.
  • Serve as a trusted executive advisor. Lead executive-facing QBRs and long-term partnership discussions; drive alignment across a large, multi-stakeholder client organization.
  • Anticipate and mitigate risk. Surface and address risk well before it impacts retention, expansion, or reputation.
  • Operate effectively under high expectations. Work with senior stakeholders in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment. Ability to receive direct feedback constructively, separate delivery style from substance, and maintain steady progress is essential.

Success Looks Like

  • Strong retention and expansion on a complex, high-value account.
  • Lead complex cross-functional project management, coordinating stakeholders across teams to align priorities, manage dependencies, and ensure initiatives are delivered on time and against key objectives.
  • Deep executive trust with senior client stakeholders and with internal executive leadership.
  • Consistently high-quality strategic deliverables produced with minimal rework.
  • Clear, measurable contribution to how Thrive delivers value on its most strategically important health/pharma accounts.

Qualifications & Skills

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent relevant experience
  • 8–12+ years in Customer Success, account management, or client delivery — this is the non-negotiable core of the role
  • Experience owning enterprise, multi-stakeholder accounts with significant complexity and deal size.
  • Demonstrated experience creating structured, executive-ready plans (roadmaps, communications calendars, rollout timelines) from ambiguous or evolving direction — not just executing against an existing template or playbook.
  • Strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and program management skills.
  • Communications/PR fluency is a plus, not a requirement — comfort with communications concepts and terminology is important, but deep expertise is not expected.
  • Familiarity with regulated-industry review processes (e.g., MLR/PRC-style approval steps) is a plus.
  • Experience using Salesforce, G Suite, Microsoft products, and Zoom; familiarity with Coda, Looker, or similar tools is a plus.

Who You Are

  • You've built your career on being genuinely excellent at account management and client delivery, and along the way you've developed the range to take on work that goes beyond a standard CSM job description. Given a high-level ask, you can independently shape a first version and refine it with feedback, rather than requiring a template.
  • A proven, strategic customer success leader experienced with complex, high-revenue engagements.
  • Highly skilled at aligning executive and administrative stakeholders to drive renewals, expansion, and referrals.
  • Comfortable operating autonomously in ambiguous environments, with strong prioritization and anticipation of needs.
  • Comfortable giving and receiving compassionately direct feedback.
  • A confident, optimistic, solutions-oriented operator who brings both rigor and heart to the work.
  • Passionate about well-being, performance, and the human impact of technology.

✨ What We Offer:

🌍 Mission-Driven Impact: Be part of a company that’s truly making a difference in people’s lives around the world.

🚀 Career Growth: Develop within the company and help shape our growth strategy.

💙 Human-Centric Culture: Thrive in a supportive environment with a range of wellness perks and benefits.

💰 Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a comprehensive and rewarding total compensation package.

🩺 Health & Financial Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage plus a 401(k) program with company match.

🌴 Time to Recharge: Generous paid time-off programs designed to help you rest, reset, and recharge — including Thrive Time, a benefit unique to Thrive that gives employees additional paid time off after major projects or intense periods of work to truly recharge and recover.

Compensation:

Base compensation for this role will likely fall in the $136,000-$165,000 range.

  • Please note: We provide a competitive mix of salary, performance bonus, and equity. The final offer amount will depend on factors like experience, expertise, and may differ from the range above. This range also excludes additional benefits, such as 401(k), and medical, dental, or vision insurance.

raw.description:
Job Title: Solutions Engineer

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Solutions Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Solutions Engineer, you are the technical owner of the merchant relationship from first sales conversation through live integration and beyond. You will focus on our enterprise and strategic merchants: the national retailers and high-volume brands running custom, hand-built integrations across web, mobile app, and in-store. These are our most complex merchants and our largest revenue drivers, and they do not come with an off-the-shelf plugin.

You will partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope what a merchant needs, design the integration that gets them there, and stay with them once they are live. You own the technical side of pre-sales: demos, architecture discussions, RFP responses, and solution proposals. When a merchant needs something custom, you define the requirement, shape the solution with our engineering team, and drive it to launch.

This is a customer-facing engineering role. You will spend as much time on calls with merchant developers as you will in documentation and test environments, and you need to be credible in both rooms.

This role combines technical expertise and sales acumen to support sales teams. They work closely with the sales team and clients, understanding customer needs and translating them into effective, tailored solutions. Acting as a bridge between technical and business functions, a Solutions Engineer not only helps demonstrate and implement the product’s capabilities but also communicates complex technical details in a way that resonates with clients. Their role requires both the ability to engage with customers directly and the technical know-how to ensure the product meets client requirements effectively.

What You'll Do:

  • Own technical discovery for prospective merchants: understand their stack, their checkout flow, and their constraints, then map them to the right Sezzle integration path
  • Lead product demos and technical presentations for merchant engineering and business stakeholders
  • Design integration solutions across our API, SDKs, and platform plugins (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix, and custom builds)
  • Write technical proposals and complete RFP and security questionnaire responses
  • Support merchant mobile app integrations: SDK implementation, in-app checkout, and native versus webview handoff
  • Validate integrations in sandbox and in production before launch, including checkout flow, widget and messaging placement, redirect and handoff behavior, and settlement
  • Troubleshoot live integration issues alongside Support and Engineering, and own the technical narrative back to the merchant
  • Translate recurring merchant needs into product feedback, and push for the fixes that unblock revenue
  • Build and maintain integration documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement so the team scales without you in every call
  • Act as the trusted technical advisor for your merchants after launch, spotting optimization opportunities they haven't asked for yet

What We Look For:

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role: solutions engineering, sales engineering, implementation, solutions architecture, or technical account management
  • Experience with mobile SDK integrations on iOS and Android, including the ability to guide merchant mobile developers through implementation and debug what breaks
  • Experience supporting enterprise merchants through complex, multi-stakeholder integrations with custom-built commerce stacks
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and reading API documentation critically
  • Working knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Familiarity with at least one major e-commerce platform (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix) and how payment methods integrate into it
  • Understanding of e-commerce workflows: cart, checkout, payment authorization and capture, refunds, shipping, and product management
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, and business context clearly to engineers
  • Strong written communication. You will produce documentation and proposals that merchants and internal teams rely on
  • Comfort managing several merchant integrations at once in a fast-moving environment
  • Ability to read code in at least one language well enough to debug a merchant's implementation
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in day-to-day work, including research, technical documentation, problem-solving, and workflow automation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a payments company, PSP, or BNPL provider
  • Familiarity with payment gateway architecture and how alternative payment methods are surfaced at checkout
  • Experience with in-store or omnichannel payment integrations
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Use your skills to make an impact

Occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

There are holiday and weekend requirements for this role.

Very minimal travel might be required for training, meetings, and/or conferences

License/Credential Requirement

At the time of hire, physician must have an active, unencumbered license in at least one of the states that are part of the specific cluster (Louisiana, Oklahoma, Indiana, Ohio, Florida, Virginia, Kentucky).

Reporting Relationship:

This position reports directly to the Cluster Lead Medical Director.

How We Value You

  • Benefits starting day 1 of employment

  • Competitive 401k match

  • Generous Paid Time Off accrual

  • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Parental Leave

Interview Process

As part of our hiring process, we will be using on-demand technology provided by Hire Vue, a third-party vendor. This technology provides our team of recruiters and hiring managers an enhanced method for decision-making through on-demand candidate assessments.

If you are selected to move forward from your application prescreen, you will receive correspondence inviting you to participate in an on-demand assessment with pre-determined questions. You should anticipate the assessment to take approximately 10-15 minutes.

Your on-demand assessment will be reviewed, and you will subsequently be informed if you will be moving forward to next round of interviews.

SSN Task via Workday

Should you be extended a formal employment offer you will receive a request to enter your SSN into our Workday system to scan for duplicate profiles.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$223,800 - $313,100 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

Responsabilidades Principales

  • Identificar e integrar casos de uso viables para IA generativa y agentes en procesos críticos: automatización, recomendación, análisis, interacción.

Requirements

  • 4+ años de experiencia como Product Manager en soluciones tecnológicas o plataformas digitales.
  • Conocimiento sólido del ciclo de vida de productos de IA aplicada a negocio, incluyendo agentes, LLMs, NLP o modelos de recomendación.

  • Experiencia Implementando soluciones de IA conversacional con diferentes canales de IM (Whatsapp, Telegram, etc) y experiencia con modelos de pricing con esos canales
  • Experiencia en analisis y estudio de Mercado, estudio de competencia, etc.

Plus / Deseables (Nice to Have)

  • Conocimiento en monetización de datos, licenciamiento de modelos, o marketplaces de data/IA.
  • Experiencia previa en startups o scaleups AI-first.
  • Familiaridad con conceptos como LangChain, RAG, copilots empresariales, agentes autónomos o frameworks como CrewAI, AutoGen.
  • Conocimiento de productos relacionados con ERP, payroll, facturación, contabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Conocimiento básico de modelos de pricing de AI (token-based, tiered usage, performance-based).

Backed by Toloka’s deep expertise in scalable data generation, crowd technology, and applied ML systems, Mindrift enables experts to shape how next-generation generative models learn, reason, and perform.

We are launching a Management Consulting domain focused on translating real-world consulting engagements into structured learning environments for advanced AI systems. To do this credibly, we are assembling a team of strategy consultants from top-tier firms who can convert authentic project experience into end-to-end examples — from problem structuring and work planning to analysis, synthesis, and client-ready recommendations.

You will join a growing team of consultants from leading strategy firms shaping how AI learns high-level business reasoning.

Important: This role is exclusively for consultants with direct experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm. If you do not have hands-on project experience at one of the firms listed below, please do not apply. This requirement ensures the domain is built by practitioners trained to the highest standards of structured problem-solving and client delivery.

Eligible firms: McKinsey & Company, Boston Consulting Group (BCG), Bain & Company, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Monitor Deloitte (Deloitte S&C), EY-Parthenon, Kearney, and Strategy& (PwC).

Who We’re Looking For

Consultants with 3+ years of experience at one of the firms listed above, with hands-on project experience in:

  • Structuring ambiguous client problems into workable analytical plans
  • Building financial models, market analyses, or synthesized findings from messy inputs
  • Producing client-ready deliverables under time pressure
  • Forming and defending recommendations under uncertainty

No deep technical background is required — we will onboard you on the lightweight tools involved.

What You’ll Do

  • Build realistic consulting project environments — create detailed project scenarios grounded in real engagement dynamics: industry context, financials, constraints, conflicting inputs, and incomplete information.
  • Design structured consulting tasks for AI agents — break projects into discrete tasks that mirror real consulting work: market sizing, commercial due diligence, cost optimization, growth strategy, operational diagnosis, benchmarking, and more.
  • Define evaluation criteria and quality standards — develop grading frameworks, evaluation rubrics, and golden-answer solutions for each task, used to train and calibrate an LLM-based grading system that evaluates AI outputs at scale.

This is a remote, project-based, individual-contributor role focused on analytical design and evaluation.

Skills & Requirements

  • 3+ years at McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Monitor Deloitte, EY-Parthenon, Kearney, or Strategy&
  • Strong structured problem-solving and hypothesis-driven thinking
  • Ability to translate vague problems into clear analytical steps and deliverables
  • High attention to logical consistency and output quality
  • Independent, self-directed working style
  • Clear written English (B2+)

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $60 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 25-30 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

  • Lead complex and large-account underwriting decisions; serve as the technical authority and escalation point for the team

  • Maintain a disciplined approach to accumulation management, ensuring adherence to CAT exclusions (no Tier 1 Wind, Flood, or EQ/EQSL)

  • Drive use of underwriting indications to enable broker partners to set accurate client expectations and accelerate decisioning

Portfolio Management & Profitability

  • Monitor and actively manage loss ratios, combined ratios, and portfolio trends; take corrective action when segments underperform

  • Partner with actuarial and finance on pricing adequacy, rate monitoring, and reserving inputs

  • Analyze submission flow, hit ratios, and renewal retention to identify where the book is growing well and where it needs tightening

  • Balance profitable growth with underwriting discipline — new premium is only valuable if it performs

Team Management & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10 property underwriters across experience levels

  • Establish clear performance expectations, accountability frameworks, and a culture of continuous improvement

  • Recruit and retain underwriting talent; build bench strength for future growth

  • Foster a team environment that rewards technical rigor, sound judgment, and broker responsiveness

Wholesale Distribution

  • Cultivate and deepen relationships with key wholesale broker partners; serve as a senior point of contact for strategic accounts

  • Collaborate with production and distribution leadership to identify appetite gaps and market opportunities

  • Represent Skyward at industry events, broker meetings, and wholesale market forums

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with claims, actuarial, legal, and product teams to ensure the book is supported end-to-end

  • Provide market and competitive intelligence to inform product development and pricing strategy

  • Partner with technology and operations to improve submission handling, data quality, and underwriting workflow efficiency

Experience

  • 10+ years of E&S or specialty property underwriting experience, with meaningful time in a wholesale/non-admitted environment

  • Prior leadership experience managing underwriting teams; comfort operating as both a strategic leader and technical contributor

  • Demonstrated track record of building or managing a profitable property book across a broad range of commercial classes

Technical Skills

  • Deep knowledge of commercial property underwriting, including COPE analysis, rate-on-line assessment, and coverage structure

  • Familiarity with layered property structures (ground-up, primary, quota share, and excess)

  • Working knowledge of ISO and proprietary property forms

  • Proficiency in evaluating equipment breakdown, property enhancement, and schedule risks

  • Strong understanding of CAT modeling concepts and accumulation management principles

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Strong communicator and relationship builder — credible with both wholesale brokers and internal executive stakeholders

  • Data-driven decision-maker with the ability to translate portfolio analytics into actionable strategy

  • High accountability orientation; comfortable owning results and making hard calls on underperforming segments

  • Collaborative and team-oriented, with the ability to develop talent and build a high-performance culture

Compensation & Benefits

The applicable base salary for this opportunity is $235,000 - $270,000. The base pay offered will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. In addition to the base salary, this opportunity may be eligible for performance-based incentives.​ We are excited to offer a competitive total rewards package which includes health and welfare benefits, tuition and professional certification assistance, 401k savings, elective participation in the Employee Stock Purchase Program, paid time off, paid holidays, and child bonding leave, as well as other employee assistance.

raw.description:
Video Editor (Adobe Premiere, Social Media & Marketing Content) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours, with flexibility for launches, campaigns, and deadlines

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring a Video Editor for one of our clients to create engaging, polished, and performance-driven video content across social media, marketing campaigns, paid advertising, websites, and internal communications.

This is more than a technical editing role. You’ll be responsible for turning raw footage into compelling stories designed to capture attention, increase watch time, improve audience retention, and strengthen campaign performance.

You’ll create and optimize content across platforms including TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, LinkedIn, websites, and paid advertising channels.

If you understand how editing pace, storytelling, hooks, visuals, and platform-specific formats influence content performance, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Video Editing & Content Creation

  • Edit raw footage into polished, engaging, and professional videos.
  • Create both short-form and long-form content.
  • Work with editing platforms such as:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Final Cut Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
  • Build edits around strong storytelling, pacing, and audience attention.
  • Create compelling openings and maintain viewer interest throughout each video.
  • Align every edit with brand guidelines, campaign objectives, and marketing goals.
  • Adapt editing styles based on platform, audience, and content purpose.

Social Media & Platform Optimization

  • Create platform-native video content for:
    • TikTok
    • Instagram Reels
    • YouTube & YouTube Shorts
    • LinkedIn
    • Websites
    • Paid advertising campaigns
  • Adapt content into multiple aspect ratios, including:
    • 16:9
    • 9:16
    • 1:1
  • Repurpose footage into multiple pieces of content without making each version feel repetitive.
  • Optimize exports for the appropriate combination of quality, file size, and platform requirements.
  • Understand how editing styles differ between short-form social content, long-form video, and advertising creative.

Motion Graphics & Visual Enhancements

  • Add professional:
    • Captions
    • Titles
    • Lower thirds
    • Motion graphics
    • Transitions
    • Visual overlays
  • Use tools such as Adobe After Effects and Canva when appropriate.
  • Maintain consistent typography, visual language, and brand presentation.
  • Enhance videos without over-editing or distracting from the core message.

Audio & Color

  • Clean and balance audio for professional output.
  • Improve dialogue clarity and reduce unwanted background noise.
  • Handle audio syncing and volume leveling.
  • Add appropriate licensed music and sound effects.
  • Perform color correction and grading.
  • Maintain visual consistency between different cameras, clips, and environments.

Footage & Project Management

  • Import, organize, and maintain raw footage and creative assets.
  • Keep project files and folder structures clean and consistent.
  • Maintain clear version control throughout revision cycles.
  • Archive completed projects so footage and assets can be easily retrieved and repurposed.
  • Manage multiple editing projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Collaboration & Revisions

  • Work closely with:
    • Marketing teams
    • Content strategists
    • Creative teams
  • Receive and manage feedback through tools such as Frame.io and shared review systems.
  • Turn revisions around quickly while maintaining quality.
  • Communicate clearly about timelines, creative requirements, and deliverables.
  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback without losing consistency or creative direction.

Performance Optimization

  • Review content performance metrics including:
    • Watch time
    • Audience retention
    • Engagement
    • CTR
  • Identify patterns in high- and low-performing content.
  • Apply performance insights to future edits.
  • Collaborate with marketing teams to test new hooks, formats, pacing, and creative approaches.
  • Continuously improve editing decisions based on actual audience behavior.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You understand that great video editing is about storytelling and attention, not just transitions and effects.
  • You know how to make the opening seconds of a video count.
  • You can edit both short-form and long-form content effectively.
  • You understand how content consumption differs across TikTok, Reels, YouTube, LinkedIn, and paid ads.
  • You can execute quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • You’re highly organized and comfortable managing multiple projects.
  • You take ownership of your work from raw footage through final export.
  • You’re receptive to feedback and can handle revision cycles professionally.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional video editing experience.
  • Strong proficiency with one or more of:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Final Cut Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
  • Experience editing social media and marketing content.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Video pacing
    • Storytelling
    • Viewer retention
    • Platform-specific content
  • Experience with:
    • Audio cleanup and syncing
    • Color correction
    • Captions and graphics
    • Multi-platform formatting
    • Platform-specific exports
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating professional video editing work.

Preferred Experience

  • Adobe After Effects and motion graphics experience.
  • Experience editing:
    • Paid advertising creatives
    • UGC-style videos
    • Performance marketing content
    • Short-form social content
    • Long-form YouTube content
  • Familiarity with performance metrics such as:
    • Watch time
    • Audience retention
    • CTR
    • Engagement
  • Experience using Frame.io or similar creative review platforms.
  • Background supporting:
    • SaaS companies
    • E-commerce brands
    • Marketing agencies
    • Media companies

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Video Editor’s day revolves around turning raw footage into content people actually want to watch. You will:

  • Review and organize incoming footage and creative briefs.
  • Edit short-form and long-form videos.
  • Create social media and marketing campaign content.
  • Add captions, graphics, transitions, and sound design.
  • Perform audio cleanup and color correction.
  • Create platform-specific versions and exports.
  • Review feedback and complete revisions.
  • Analyze content performance to improve future edits.
  • Archive completed projects and maintain organized creative files.

In short: you transform raw footage into polished, platform-native video content that captures attention, tells a compelling story, and drives measurable engagement.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery of video projects.
  • Strong audience watch time and retention.
  • Improved engagement across video content.
  • Consistent brand quality across platforms.
  • Reduced and efficient revision cycles.
  • Accurate platform-specific formatting and delivery.
  • Organized, scalable project and asset management.
  • Positive feedback from marketing and creative stakeholders.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership over creative output.
  • Direct impact on marketing and content performance.
  • Opportunity to create content across multiple platforms and formats.
  • Exposure to organic social, paid advertising, and brand content.
  • Performance-driven environment where creative decisions can be measured.
  • Fully remote collaboration with U.S.-based teams.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Video Editor
    • Creative Lead
    • Senior Content Producer
    • Content Director

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Portfolio Review + Practical Editing Task
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you:

  • Love video editing and visual storytelling
  • Understand Adobe Premiere Pro and modern editing workflows
  • Know what makes social media content engaging
  • Can edit for both short-form and long-form formats
  • Understand pacing, hooks, watch time, and audience retention
  • Thrive in a fast-moving creative environment

We’d love to see your work.

Apply today with your portfolio or video editing reel and help create content that captures attention, strengthens brands, and drives performance.

Business Area:

Product Mgmt.

Seniority Level:

Job Description:

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

As a designer at Cloudera your main focus is to let your curiosity drive you. You will use your passion and knowledge to create precision-crafted designs that bring simplicity and innovation to our products and services. The Cloudera Platform helps customers manage the lifecycle of their data, from the edge to AI. Our hybrid data platform delivers unprecedented value to our customers and is key to our overall strategy and success. We need an experienced and talented designer to drive enterprise ready improvements and cross cutting product design initiatives related to the Cloudera Platform.

You will be leading the full user-centered design process, from user interviews, competitor analysis, high fidelity interface designs, prototypes, feature validation, and working with engineering to uphold the quality of implementation. All while partnering closely with other designers and your product triad to deliver the most usable solutions possible. Additionally, you will work closely with the entire design team to improve our process, our design system, and our design culture. The culture of the Cloudera Design team is human first, we actively seek to grow each member’s career through outside education and candid, compassionate feedback from other experienced designers.

As a Lead UX Designer you will:

  • Design user flows, diagrams, wireframes, and designs to satisfy product requirements and follow product design standards.

  • Create high-fidelity visual designs and/or prototypes that demonstrate user flows.

  • Deliver design specifications and supporting assets to the development teams.

  • Participate in design reviews to collect feedback from designers and stakeholders.

  • Facilitate collaborative workshops that unlock innovation.

  • Be the champion of the Product Triad to inspire meaningful collaboration to help your team realize their best work possible

  • Iterate on existing application features to improve usability and drive key metrics.

  • Assist in the planning and estimating of design activities, participating in broader workflow coordination and setting of expectations.

  • Conduct product research and usability studies.

  • Dive deep into domain research, understanding the customers and the technology.

  • Conduct competitive analysis of other products and services.

  • Contribute to and maintain design pattern libraries.

  • Provide mentorship and guidance to other members of the design team.

We are excited if you have (Required Experience):

  • 6+ years of professional experience in UX design, UI design, product design, and/or web

  • Self-starter with excellent time management skills and ability to handle multiple projects with shifting priorities.

  • Portfolio exhibiting the ability to conceptualize and demonstrate visual communication skills. Examples of process and design approaches are highly recommended.

  • Strong understanding of user centered design processes and methodology, particularly as applied to enterprise software, PAAS, and on-prem applications.

  • Mastery of design principles with a firm understanding of grid systems, typography, and color.

  • A strong attention to detail and consistency in design.

  • Experience in coordinating and conducting qualitative and quantitative research, including usability studies, discovery interviews, and product analytics data analysis.

  • Strong collaborator experienced in working with cross-functional, international teams.

  • Demonstrable systems thinking skills.

  • Proficient in Figma, Figma Make, Zeplin, and relevant AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field required or equivalent experience.

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required.

  • Experience working with cloud, on-prem and hybrid data platforms, or other similar technologies.

You might also have:

  • Strong opinions & curiosity of AI & Design, along with your own experiments, workflows and AI x design processes.

  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, front-end javascript frameworks, and mobile centric design patterns.

  • Experience designing for data streaming, data engineering, data warehousing, machine learning and AI applications.

This is a full-time contract role.

The anticipated hourly range for this position is: 65.00-70.00/HR

Individual compensation within the published range is determined by the candidate's skills, experience, qualifications, and primary work location. In addition to base pay, sales roles are eligible for Cloudera's commission plan, while non-sales roles are eligible for the corporate incentive plan. All employees receive a comprehensive benefits package.

raw.description:
Join the National Leader in Cloud-Based Property Management

Our Story: 🏡

PropertyMe is Australia’s number one property management platform. With over 60% market share, more than 35,000 real estate professionals rely on PropertyMe every day to manage over 1.8 million properties across Australia and New Zealand. Backed by EQT, a global investment firm with deep expertise in technology and vertical SaaS, we’re not resting on our laurels.

We’re building something bigger. PropertyMe is expanding from a best-in-class property management platform into a connected ecosystem that brings property management, CRM, payments, trust accounting and AI-driven productivity tools together in one place. The recent launch of PropertyMe Grow – our purpose-built CRM and growth platform for real estate agencies – marks a significant new chapter. For the first time, agencies can manage their entire operation, from winning new business to managing properties and everything in between, on a single platform.

Your work here won’t be abstract. It will directly shape how thousands of Australian real estate professionals, tenants and property owners experience their day-to-day lives.

Your Mission: 🚀

We’re looking for a New Business Representative to join our mid-market sales team. This is a true hunter role focused on winning new logos and expanding existing customers.

You’ll engage agency principals and directors on platform transformation—guiding strategic conversations, not just selling software. In real estate, trust and relationships are key, and we need someone who understands that.

With PropertyMe Grow and our payments platform, you’ll bring a differentiated, multi-product story—positioning an integrated solution across operations, CRM, payments, trust accounting, and AI workflows.

Responsibilities 🏢

Win New Business

  • Identify, qualify and close new agency opportunities within defined mid-market segments across Australia and New Zealand.
  • Lead discovery conversations with agency principals and leadership teams, positioning PropertyMe as the platform that replaces fragmentation with clarity.
  • Drive daily prospecting and outbound activity – the sort of consistent, disciplined effort that turns pipeline into revenue.

Sell the Platform Story

  • Articulate the full PropertyMe ecosystem: property management operations, Grow (CRM), trust accounting, payments and AI productivity tools.
  • Demonstrate value through product demonstrations and consultative conversations, not feature dumps.
  • Guide customers through platform consolidation decisions, helping them see what their business looks like when it actually works together.

Expand Existing Accounts

  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing mid-market customers, particularly around Grow and the broader product suite.
  • Build deep relationships that naturally surface expansion opportunities, rather than relying solely on transactional touchpoints.

Build and Manage Pipeline

  • Develop a healthy pipeline through marketing-generated leads, industry relationships, events, partner introductions and your own proactive outreach.
  • Maintain impeccable pipeline hygiene and CRM accuracy in Salesforce to ensure confident forecasting and timely follow-ups.

Engage with the Industry

  • Represent PropertyMe at industry events, conferences and networking opportunities as someone who genuinely knows the space.
  • Develop relationships with franchise groups, industry bodies, influencers and agency leaders.
  • Monitor competitor activity, market trends and legislative changes – and feed those insights back to inform product and sales strategy.

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Partner with onboarding, customer success and support to ensure a seamless handover from sale to long-term platform adoption.
  • Act as a conduit between the market and our product team, ensuring customer feedback shapes what we build next.

What you bring 🌟

Required

  • A track record of success in SaaS new business sales, with experience selling into mid-market or enterprise segments.
  • Proven ability to close complex B2B deals and consistently meet or exceed revenue targets.
  • Experience engaging senior decision-makers – principals, directors and C-suite – in consultative, value-led sales conversations.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce strongly preferred).
  • The ability to self-manage, self-motivate and maintain a high-activity rhythm without someone standing over your shoulder.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience selling into the real estate or property management industry.
  • Experience in platform or multi-product SaaS sales, where cross-selling is a core growth lever.
  • A working understanding of agency operations, PropTech or the property management ecosystem.
  • Prior experience in a high-growth, PE-backed SaaS environment.

Who you are 💭

A Strategic Hunter. You get genuine satisfaction from opening doors that others walk past. You build pipeline with intent, not hope.

A Platform Storyteller. You can take a complex, multi-product ecosystem and distil it into a clear, compelling vision of what an agency’s future looks like.

A Commercial Thinker. You translate product capability into tangible operational and financial outcomes. You speak the language of business impact, not just features.

Relationship-Driven. You understand that trust takes time to build and seconds to lose. In real estate, that matters more than most industries.

Resilient and Self-Driven. You thrive in a fast-moving environment; own your territory like it’s your business and maintain the daily discipline that separates consistent performers from occasional ones.

Why PropertyMe 🩵

Market Leader – Over 60% market share in Property management This isn’t a challenger brand; it’s the platform thousands of agencies already trust.

Multi-Product Momentum – The launch of PropertyMe Grow creates a genuinely new sales motion and cross-sell opportunity that didn’t exist twelve months ago.

Backed by EQT – Serious investment behind serious ambition. The resources and strategic support to scale.

Uncapped Earning Potential – Competitive base salary plus commission structure designed to reward hunters who deliver.

Career Trajectory – A growing company with expanding teams, new products and new markets means genuine opportunities to grow with us.

Impact – Your work directly affects how real estate professionals, tenants and property owners experience their daily lives.

It’s uncertain times at the moment, but there’s nothing uncertain about the opportunity here at PropertyMe, we’re building something special and we want to chat with you about joining us, no matter your background. Apply now or check out our People & Culture team on LinkedIn, we’re always open for a chat!

raw.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As a Dedicated Sales Activation Specialist, you will support the setup and launch of our new clients 401(k) plans while representing our White Label partners. This joint effort means you'll be on the front lines with our new clients/partners, working with a wide variety of companies (anything from the local plumber to the nationwide robotics firm), helping them set up and launch their new 401(k) plans. You'll own keeping the sales activation process on-track while ensuring that customers and partners are engaged and happy. Process-driven and people-focused - you are organized, friendly and flexible.

You will be accountable for hitting key performance metrics, identifying and escalating operational blockers to consistently launch a high volume of plans while delivering an exceptional customer experience. If you are energized by helping business owners meet their goals, being challenged with monthly targets, and fast-changing environments, this is the opportunity for you. We move at 24,791 mph - you should be ready to lead at speed

What you get to do every day

  • Communicate extensively with our customers to identify their needs and help them establish their 401(k) plans
  • Educate, guide, and inform our newly signed customers about the choices they have to help their employees save for retirement
  • Meet monthly activation targets by closely working client pipelines, managing client timelines, objection handling to keep clients in the flow and ensuring adherence to process and talk tracks.
  • Actively follow onboarding workflows to increase velocity, remove bottlenecks, and drive operational excellence.
  • Partner cross-functionally with internal teams and Leadership to resolve customer escalations and continuously improve the sales activation experience.
  • Work cross-functionally within our organization (specifically with sales and account management) to make sure customer needs are met
  • Drive processes forward, managing internal and external stakeholders to keep our customers engaged, happy, and on-track
  • Communicate professionally to both internal and external clients while focusing on needs-driven solutions
  • Identify potential areas for process improvement to help the team scale

What you bring to the role

  • Possess knowledge and experience with retirement plan design, particularly in 401(k) plans
  • 3+ years of customer implementation or sales experience in a SaaS environment or retirement industry
  • A “people person” who truly enjoys interacting with clients and can communicate difficult concepts fluidly
  • Energy and passion - the concept of onboarding 40-50+ customers a month excites you - velocity is everything!
  • A strong work ethic, proactively following up with our customers and keeping them on track
  • Excellent organizational skills, are able juggle multiple tasks with varying deadlines and stakeholders without dropping the ball
  • A desire for learning new programs, systems, and expanding your knowledge about the retirement industry and our product
  • A strong focus on quality
  • Ability to easily adapt to various client systems and user interfaces and troubleshoot software issues as they arise
  • Strong PC skills, including experience working with G-Suite products
  • Ability to easily adapt to various client systems and user interfaces and troubleshoot software issues as they arise
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
  • Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
  • An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, there are a number of factors that are used to determine the appropriate pay range for each position. We take into account the cost of labor for each position in various markets across the U.S. The base salary for this position spans $67,000 - $70,000and represents the minimum in our lowest geographic region to a maximumin our highest geographic region. The salary we offer to a new employee within this range is based on their location within the U.S., their relevant job-related skills, and experience. At Human Interest, base salary is one component of the overall total rewards package. This position will also offer a variable target of $15,000 All of our employees are offered a robust suite of physical, financial, and mental wellness benefits. In compliance with applicable laws, we do not inquire about salary history, or about criminal history prior to a conditional offer of employment.

Benefits -

  • A great 401(k) plan: Our own! Our 401(k) includes a dollar-for-dollar employer match up to 4% of compensation (immediately vested) and $0 plan fees
  • Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance
  • Competitive time off and parental leave

  • Monthly work-from-home stipend; quarterly lifestyle stipend
  • Engaging team-building experiences, ranging from virtual social events to team offsites, promoting collaboration and camaraderie.

We’re a great place to work (but don’t take our word for it)

Here’s a list of our awards and accolades:

  • Certified as a Great Place To Work® (2023-2025)
  • Fortune Best Place to Work in the Bay Area (2024)
  • Best Places to Work by Built In (2023-2024)

raw.description:
Consensys is the leading blockchain and web3 software company. Founded by Joe Lubin, CEO of Consensys and Co-Founder of Ethereum in 2014, Consensys has been at the forefront of innovation, pioneering technological developments within the web3 ecosystem.

The financial system is being rebuilt on open, programmable infrastructure, and Consensys is helping power that transition. From MetaMask, the platform trusted by tens of millions of users worldwide, to Linea, the only 100% proven zkEVM rollup and an emerging home for institutional ETH capital, Consensys builds products and infrastructure that enable users, developers, and institutions to participate in the next generation of the internet.

Our mission is to unlock the collaborative power of communities by making the decentralized web universally easy to access, use, and build on.

Joining Consensys means working with a fully remote, globally distributed team of technologists, designers, cryptographers, product thinkers, and researchers who are building the next layer of the internet. You'll be exposed to new ideas, emerging technologies, and complex challenges that push you to stay at the top of your game while helping scale products and infrastructure used by tens of millions of users and thousands of developers across the web3 ecosystem. You'll join a network of builders that reaches the edge of our ecosystem. Consensys alumni have moved on to become tech entrepreneurs, CEOs, and team leads at tech companies.

About MetaMask

We’re building for a future where the internet and world economy empowers people through interactions based on consent, privacy, and free association. Where both communities and individuals flourish. To accomplish that, we’re working hard to make web3 accessible for everyone around the world.

MetaMask is both a crypto wallet and a gateway to the decentralized web. Our tools help people create communities, play video games, access financial services, make payments, invest in assets, protect against economic turmoil, and more. Our browser extension and mobile platforms meet the needs of millions of users and developers across the world.

Originally a humble key manager, today MetaMask serves over 30 million monthly active users as a decentralized application development platform, an aggregator of decentralized cryptocurrency exchanges, and a decentralized identity manager.

About the Role

MetaMask has experienced explosive user growth over the past year as a cryptographic key manager and web3 application development platform. As this user base continues to grow, an immense amount of trust is being placed in MetaMask as a tool that manages and wields their digital authority, controlling assets, identities and more. It is of highest importance to us that we keep our users as safe and secure as possible.

We are looking for a Senior Application Security Engineer to join our rapidly growing security team to help embed security into all phases of the software development lifecycle. You would work closely with development teams and product managers to ensure MetaMask products are designed and implemented to the highest security standards. Consenys’s application security team primarily supports MetaMask with opportunities to expand to additional products in the Consensys family.

To apply for this position, you must have:

  • 6+ years of experience building and securing software, including hands-on product or application security experience.
  • Experience securing modern backend systems, web applications, and APIs.
  • Experience performing threat modelling, security design reviews, and vulnerability assessment.
  • Experience securing JavaScript-based applications across web and/or mobile (Node.js, React, React Native preferred).
  • Strong coding skills, with the ability to work directly with engineers to identify and fix vulnerabilities or build secure solutions.
  • Familiarity with Blockchain technology (particularly Ethereum), Decentralized Applications and crypto wallets
  • Solid understanding of the modern web and mobile security landscape, including common attack vectors and mitigations.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence engineering decisions and collaborate effectively in a remote environment.
  • Self-driven and proactive, comfortable operating in a high-autonomy, distributed team.
  • Alignment with our mission and values.

Timezone: Most timezones will work. Regardless of where you are, some overlap with EU and US-Pacific time zones will be necessary.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working as a software developer.
  • Deep knowledge of Ethereum (and other blockchains), Decentralized Applications and crypto wallets.
  • Knowledge of smart contract implementation and security.
  • You’re a MetaMask user!

Responsibilities

  • Determine the root cause and severity of vulnerabilities reported to us through our bug bounty platform.
  • Interface with ethical hackers, triage reports, and guide product engineering teams to resolution.
  • Document identified vulnerabilities in a way that allows for our engineering team to take quick action.
  • Write code to support the development of security engineering projects, or fix vulnerabilities in MetaMask client applications. This includes the development of AI tooling for vulnerability determination and resolution in order to keep pace with the changing AI-powered vulnerability detection landscape.
  • Assess potential security vulnerabilities within our applications, and work with development teams to ensure remediation in our established SLAs.
  • Support product teams as they develop new features by conducting design reviews, threat modeling, security testing, and code reviews.
  • Identify gaps in MetaMask’s secure software development life cycle (SSDLC), and take initiative leading efforts to address them.
  • Participate and contribute to team meetings, roadmap planning, and discussions.
  • Validate that security patches address reported vulnerabilities and test for any potential bypasses
  • Proactively prevent future occurrences of a vulnerability through developing automation, security controls, and educating developers.
  • Pave your own path in how you want to make MetaMask more secure.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants will be required to submit to background checks including but not limited to employment, education and criminal record checks. Further details will be provided to applicants that successfully meet the criteria for the position as determined by the company in its sole discretion. By submitting an application for employment, you are acknowledging and consenting to this requirement.

The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.

US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)
$130,000—$218,000 USD

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At Consensys, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities with economic and political agency through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

Recruiter – Talent Acquisition Specialist | Full-Cycle Recruiting

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist to own the full recruiting lifecycle — from sourcing and screening candidates through interviews, offers, and hiring.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused recruiting role for someone who knows how to build strong candidate pipelines, assess talent effectively, and keep multiple hiring processes moving at once.

You’ll work closely with hiring managers and clients across different industries, helping them identify and secure high-quality talent while delivering an excellent candidate experience.

If you enjoy sourcing, interviewing, and turning hiring requirements into successful placements, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Manage hiring processes from initial intake through offer acceptance.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand:
    • Role requirements
    • Ideal candidate profiles
    • Hiring priorities
    • Compensation expectations
    • Hiring timelines
  • Create and optimize job descriptions to attract relevant candidates.
  • Maintain momentum across multiple open positions simultaneously.

Candidate Sourcing & Pipeline Development

  • Source active and passive candidates through:
    • LinkedIn Recruiter
    • Indeed
    • Glassdoor
    • Boolean search
    • Niche job boards
  • Build targeted candidate pipelines based on hiring requirements.
  • Conduct proactive candidate outreach.
  • Develop reusable talent pools for recurring hiring needs.
  • Evaluate sourcing channels based on candidate quality and conversion.

Screening & Interviewing

  • Conduct structured phone and video interviews.
  • Assess candidates based on:
    • Relevant experience
    • Communication skills
    • Technical or functional fit
    • Career goals
    • Role alignment
    • Culture and working-style fit
  • Administer assessments or screening exercises when required.
  • Prepare clear candidate summaries and hiring recommendations.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate interview notes in the ATS.

Candidate Experience

  • Keep candidates informed throughout every stage of the process.
  • Coordinate interviews across multiple schedules and time zones.
  • Prepare candidates for client and hiring manager interviews.
  • Manage follow-ups promptly.
  • Ensure candidates receive a professional, responsive, and organized hiring experience.

Hiring Manager & Client Partnership

  • Provide regular updates on pipeline health and hiring progress.
  • Share market feedback regarding:
    • Candidate availability
    • Compensation
    • Hiring challenges
    • Talent quality
  • Facilitate interview debriefs and hiring discussions.
  • Help hiring managers make informed decisions using structured candidate evaluations.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.

Offer Management & Hiring Support

  • Prepare and present candidate offers.
  • Support compensation discussions and negotiations.
  • Manage candidate questions during the offer stage.
  • Help reduce offer drop-off through consistent communication.
  • Coordinate hiring documentation and onboarding handoffs.

Recruiting Operations & Reporting

  • Maintain clean and accurate ATS records.
  • Track recruiting metrics including:
    • Time-to-fill
    • Source effectiveness
    • Pipeline health
    • Interview conversion rates
    • Offer acceptance
  • Maintain recruiting dashboards and hiring reports.
  • Ensure candidates move through pipeline stages accurately and efficiently.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or staffing experience.
  • Experience managing multiple open positions simultaneously.
  • Strong hands-on sourcing experience using LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • Strong Boolean search skills.
  • Experience conducting structured candidate interviews.
  • Experience with ATS platforms such as:
    • Greenhouse
    • Lever
    • JazzHR
    • iCIMS
    • Similar recruiting systems
  • Strong candidate assessment and evaluation skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.

Executive Partner, Business Services – Chief Audit Executive (CAE)

About this role:

What makes Gartner a GREAT fit for you? When you join Gartner, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team that helps the world become smarter and more connected. We’re the world’s leading research and advisory company, achieving consistent double-digit growth by steering clients toward the right decisions with business and technology insights they can’t find anywhere else. Here you’ll enjoy a collaborative work environment supporting some of the best organizations in the world. If you like working with a curious, supportive, high-performing team, then Gartner is the place for you.

When you join the Gartner Executive Partner for Chief Audit Executive team, you will experience a high-performance work environment within a company that knows no limits. Gartner Executive Partners serve as trusted advisors to our clients, who are Chief Audit Executives from organizations across all industries. This is a brand new product and a very exciting time to join the organization.

About this role: Our clients, Chief Audit Executives or the senior-most individuals responsible for Internal Audit, find themselves challenged with the pace of change impacting the Audit function and their respective organizations as companies continue to adapt and shift their business models to move faster and grow their companies in a rapidly evolving risk environment. With the support of their Executive Partner, our Gartner for CAE clients more adeptly align their audit priorities to the organization’s most critical objectives and deliver the assurance needed to help the organization more confidently achieve its objectives and manage risks. As an Executive Partner, you will have the opportunity to deliver solutions for the most critical audit and oversight challenges facing companies across all industries.

Partnering with our clients means that no two days are the same; you could be supporting the development of the overall audit department strategy and long-term vision, providing recommendations on assessing audit department productivity and capacity and creating performance metrics and budgets, advising on the audit function’s effective use of technology (including AI), or helping the CAE increase audit’s impact on the business. Clients will also look to you for advice and support on working more closely with the Audit Committee and the broader Board, CEO, and the rest of the management team on critical business goals and risks, communicating the value of the audit function, and establishing effective governance and oversight processes. You will support clients as they work to provide assurance over emerging risks to the company and support the Audit Committee in performing their oversight role. Gartner for CAE EPs serve as accountability partners through delivery of Gartner research insights and personal experiences/expertise on key initiatives, priorities, and strategies of their CAE clients.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide executive advisory services to CAE members who work across all industries and business models.
  • Synthesize Gartner insights and data to deliver world class advisory support through ongoing bi-weekly client engagement and periodic client working sessions. The ability and willingness to operate independently to adapt materials fit for client use is required.
  • Host, facilitate, and/or participate in periodic client activities, including working sessions to develop strategy, peer roundtables, sessions and client meetings at the annual conference and virtual webinars. These activities may be delivered virtually or on-site depending on circumstance.
  • Define and deliver innovative solutions by assessing client needs and developing a customized value plan in accordance with overall Executive Program strategy and product deliverables.
  • Facilitate member interaction and peer collaboration through the Gartner for Audit member community portal and assisted member connections.
  • Work as a collaborative Gartner team member serving clients in conjunction with Client Support Professionals and Account Executives.
  • Participate in all phases of the client lifecycle: pre-sale, on-boarding, relationship management, delivery, review, and renewal.
  • While you will not be responsible for creating content, you will be partnering with Business and Technology Insights (BTI) Analysts to help identify potential gaps in material that is relevant and valuable to our clients.
  • There will be a considerable focus on sales enablement in this role. You are responsible for client retention and for contributing to account growth through direct support of Gartner Sales Associates:
  • Working with the sales teams to help them understand the true value of the Guided Product to the client vs the Self-Directed product.
  • Building their confidence and ability to effectively engage with and sell to this level of C-suite prospect.
  • Through the creation of Value Stories, enable the sales associates to bring the service to life.
  • You will be partnering with sales on account planning / development activities as well as being present in proof-of-concept (POC) engagements with prospective clients.

What You’ll Need

  • The Executive Partner will be an accomplished Chief Audit Executive, working with the C-suite, the Audit Committee and Board of Directors and a host of stakeholders, with a broad base of expertise who has operated at a senior leadership level and driven change at all levels.
  • Deep experience working as a CAE (or the highest audit role within an organization) and at least 15+ years of experience in areas critical to leading an audit function.
  • An in-depth understanding of the Audit function and other adjacent functions, e.g., Compliance, Legal & Risk.
  • Ideally with a background across multiple industries to be able to support a wide variety of member organizations.
  • Audit or Consulting Firm experience, including client relationship management, is also highly beneficial.
  • Technologically savvy; our model is lean, and you’ll leverage AI and other tools to work quickly, including completing administrative tasks.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office suite of tools to adapt Power Points, leverage Excel Spreadsheets, and to use Word to draft client-ready materials.
  • Consulting background a plus.
  • Financial Services and Banking industry experience is a plus

Who You Are

  • Critical thinker and problem solver, demonstrating the ability to assess our clients’ situations and provide actionable, outcome-based business/technical advice as well as the ability to leverage appropriate Gartner resources to help clients achieve results.
  • Ability to build strategic internal partnerships with key roles across the organization and positively impact change
  • This role is a client-facing position that requires a high level of executive presence and ability to quickly build trust and deliver value.
  • Demonstrate superior verbal and written communication skills as well as strong facilitation and presentation and facilitation skills. Excellent communication and relationship management skills
  • Willing to work independently and handle administrative tasks.

THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION THAT CAN BE LOCATED ANYWHERE IN THE MAINLAND UNITED STATES.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 188,000 USD - 225,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.
