Job Responsibilities

Job Description

Biostatistician – Real-World Evidence (RWE)

Role Overview

We are seeking a biostatistician with strong experience in real-world data (RWD) with observational study design and safety study experience in addition to RWE Safety experience. This role will support evidence generation across multiple therapeutic areas. This role will focus on the design, analysis, and interpretation of observational studies using EMR and claims data to inform: clinical development, HEOR, regulatory strategy, and market access.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and execute real-world evidence (RWE) studies using EMR and claims data; Conducting data specs, SAP and protocol with key research objectives

  • Develop and apply robust statistical methodologies, including:

  • Causal inference methods (e.g., propensity score methods, weighting, matching; GLM or GLMM, MMRM; survival analysis; random forest)

  • Trial emulation frameworks

  • External control arm development and borrowing strategies

  • Perform data analysis using healthcare coding systems (e.g., ICD, NDC)

  • Conduct sample size estimation and power calculations for observational and hybrid study designs

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders across:

  • HEOR

  • Market Access

  • Regulatory

  • Clinical Development

  • Translate complex analytical results into clear, actionable insights, e.g. powerpoint or study report for decision-making

  • Support methodological innovation in RWE, including integration of machine learning approaches where appropriate

Required Qualifications

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Biostatistics, Statistics, Epidemiology, or related field

  • ≥5 years of experience in RWD/RWE analytics (industry or equivalent)

  • Strong experience with EMR and/or claims data

  • Proficiency in healthcare coding systems (e.g., ICD, NDC)

  • Programming expertise in at least one of: SAS, R, or Python

  • Working knowledge with SQL logic and OMOP data structures

  • Solid understanding of:

  • Causal inference methods

  • Observational study design

  • Sample size and power considerations

  • Some examples: Independently write cohort definitions in SQL logic; Debug data issues e.g., time zero alignment, exposure gaps; Understand concept mapping (ICD ↔ SNOMED ↔ RxNorm); Translate statistical estimand → censoring rule and data extraction logic.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ph.D. strongly preferred

  • Familiarity with:

  • Trial emulation methodologies

  • External control borrowing / hybrid designs

  • Basic machine learning methods applied to RWD

  • Demonstrated ability to work across multiple therapeutic areas (TAs) in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills

  • Advanced (nice-to-have, not always required)

  • Build reusable cohort pipelines

  • Optimize queries for large-scale databases

  • Work across multiple CDMs (OMOP, Sentinel, PCORnet)

Core Competencies

  • Analytical rigor and methodological depth

  • Cross-functional collaboration

  • Ability to operate with agility across diverse projects and therapeutic areas

  • Clear and effective scientific communication

 

Open to all US states and Canada. Remote based position.

This role is the backbone of our vendor oversight, ensuring that every partnership—from non-critical services to complex bank integrations—aligns with our high standards for security, compliance, and operational excellence. Exceptional candidates may receive salaries outside of the posted ranges.

What You'll Do:

  • Standards & Governance: work cross-functionally with IT, Legal, and Compliance teams to establish and maintain third-party risk standards and governance practices.
  • Due Diligence & Monitoring: Conduct comprehensive vendor due diligence and ongoing monitoring activities, including evaluating consumer-impact risk, complaint analysis, and confirming privacy and data protection standards.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Manage third-party risk documentation and reporting, including maintaining the vendor and data processor inventory, ensuring timely onboarding and offboarding due diligence, and executing periodic compliance reviews.
  • Risk Assessment: Execute day-to-day risk assessments to determine vendor criticality and identify inherent risks in categories such as PII handling, BSA/AML, and credit decisioning.
  • Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with Legal to ensure effective contracts are in place and with Information Security to validate the technical safeguards of our third-party partners.

  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience in vendor risk management, procurement, or third-party compliance, preferably within the fintech or regulated financial services industry.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of third-party risk management lifecycle and regulatory guidance (e.g., PCI-DSS, SOC 2, GLBA, and BSA/AML).

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, or equivalent practical experience.

About ClickHouse

Recognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With more than 4,000 customers and ARR that has grown over 250 percent year over year, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads.

The company’s sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.

We’re on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

We are currently expanding our Support Services team at ClickHouse, which delivers exceptional service to our customers worldwide. We are seeking a Senior Consulting Engineerto join our global team, where you'll provide Consultative Support to our ClickHouse enterprise customers. The role uniquely blends hands-on engineering, development assistance, and high-tier support, performing functions across Consultative Support, Engineering, and Support. You will work directly with a set of strategic customers, providing guidance, case answers, and technical oversight. Consulting Engineers will also be assisting with support cases for customers in our Support L1 to L3 tiers, particularly when not assigned to larger projects.

Note: We are hiring for this role in Japan. Your exact location within the country does not matter as the role is not office-based. There will be on-site travel to provide in-person support to customers in Tokyo.

Responsibilities:

  • Project Engineering & Consulting (50%): Serve as a team member on customer projects, focusing on design, architecture, integration, implementation, and documentation. This includes research, benchmarking, performance and functional testing, reference architectures, sizing, migration, integration, development, and tooling.
  • Consultative Support (50%): Provide case-initiated consultative support to strategic users, customers, and prospects, assisting with implementation, onboarding, production launches, and Proof of Concepts (POCs).
  • Provide architectural, technical, and migration assistance, including hands-on tasks.
  • Work as a member of the Support Team, handling L1 to L3 cases and communications when not actively assigned to customer projects.
  • Partner closely with ClickHouse Product Management, Engineering, and Sales to contribute to the product roadmap and account plans.
  • Develop and assist with a wide range of content, including Public and Internal Documentation, Knowledge Base articles, ClickHouse Learning, Reference Architecture, blogs, and benchmark results.
  • Assist with hiring and mentoring new team members as we grow and scale.
  • Be available for scheduling and on-call needs to deliver high-quality 24x7 support in a global, distributed environment, including up to 35% estimated onsite regional travel.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in Professional Services, Support, Technical Accounts Management, Engineering/SRE, and/or Project Management roles.
  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience in implementing, operating, and/or supporting scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed database management systems ("DBMS").
  • Technical breadth and depth in relevant subjects such as DBMS, OLAP, Cloud/SaaS platforms, distributed systems software engineering, Linux/Unix, Kubernetes, System or Network Administration, and big data.
  • Experience leading and shipping large scope technical projects in collaboration with multiple experienced engineers.
  • Expertise with a public cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure) and their infrastructure as a service offering (e.g. EC2)

Bonus points:

  • Experience with ClickHouse
  • Experience with OSS and open-source technologies, as a user, community member, or contributor
  • Experience with Azure, GCP or AWS
  • Experience with data pipelines such as Kafka, Kinesis, Spark, RabbitMQ, or others

You'll love this role if:

  • You have excellent communication skills and thrive in a customer-facing role, collaborating closely with Support Services, Engineering, and Sales teams.
  • You are self-driven, curious, and eager to continuously learn and grow.
  • You possess a mindset of teamwork, global engagement, empathy, and a drive for solving challenging problems.
  • You have a sense of adventure and urgency in building the most scalable, highest performing, largest, and fastest databases in the world.

Compensation

For roles based in the United States, the typical starting salary range for this position is listed above. In certain locations, such as the San Francisco Bay Area and the New York City Metro Area, a premium market range may apply, as listed.

These salary ranges reflect what we reasonably and in good faith believe to be the minimum and maximum pay for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation may be higher or lower than the amounts listed, and the ranges may be subject to future adjustments.

An individual’s placement within the range will depend on various factors, including (but not limited to) education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, location, performance, and the needs of the business or organization.

If you have any questions or comments about compensation as a candidate, please get in touch with us at .

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 20 countries.
  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.
  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
  • A $500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.
  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

At eLEND, we’re modernizing mortgage — combining human expertise with smart automation and AI-powered tools to create faster, simpler, and more personalized home financing experiences. Every role here is a chance to be part of shaping the future of mortgage lending.

As a Senior Account Executive on our Wholesale Sales team, you’ll play a vital role in driving eLEND’s growth by building strong, lasting broker relationships. You’ll leverage your sales acumen, product knowledge, and exceptional customer service skills to help brokers find the right loan solutions for their clients’ needs. This role directly impacts eLEND’s success by expanding market reach, increasing production volume, and ensuring a superior client experience. You’ll be supported by leadership that values your expertise, trusts your judgment, and empowers you to succeed.

  • Proven experience in mortgage sales or wholesale lending, with a track record of achieving or exceeding sales goals.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and analytical skills.

  • Self-motivated, results-driven, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.

  • A commitment to delivering exceptional client experiences and long-term relationship growth.

  • Patience, persistence, and an inner drive to succeed.

Your days will include:

  • Checking your pipeline to monitor loan performance and follow up with brokers.

  • Attending virtual team meetings and sharing market insights with leadership.

At eLEND, we recognize the value of flexibility and collaboration. This role is fully remote, allowing you to manage your pipeline and client relationships from anywhere while staying connected with your team virtually.

Physical Requirements:

Join ShopMy – Powering the Future of Digital Marketing

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. We help brands run performance-driven creator programs while enabling top creators to monetize their influence and partner directly with the brands they love—driving discovery through trusted tastemakers and authentic recommendations.

ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.

At ShopMy, you're building the future of human-led commerce for the world's best brands, tastemakers, and shoppers. You move fast and see immediate impact in your work, alongside accomplished teammates who are driven by helping find the world's best things. If you’re excited to help shape the future of curated commerce at the intersection of technology, culture, and taste, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role:

As our founding PR & Communications hire, you will build and own our earned media function—shaping the stories we tell, the channels we use, and the voices that represent us. This foundational role requires a nuanced media strategy, relying on strong relationships across business, trade, creator, technology, and consumer media.

Reporting to our Head of Marketing and working closely with our founders, you will turn company priorities, data, product developments, and market trends into compelling stories that build brand awareness.

Roles and responsibilities…

  • PR Strategy: Build and lead ShopMy's earned media strategy, both holistically and by channel—targeting relevant media for Brands, Creators, and Shoppers.
  • Story & Channel Development: Identify the right stories, audiences, spokespeople, and channels—from traditional press and podcasts to speaking opportunities and executive social.
  • Media Relations: Bring trusted relationships with influential reporters and editors across business, technology, marketing, retail, fashion, and culture and invest in building our existing relationships.
  • Executive Strategy: Develop thought leadership strategy and platforms, draft talking points and quotes, schedule and prep for interviews and speaking opportunities for founders and executives.
  • Data & Launch Storytelling: Turn proprietary insights, product launches, partnerships, and milestones into repeatable media moments.
  • Rapid Response and Crisis Management: Proactively plan for situations requiring crisis management. In the moment, manage inbound press, timely commentary, and communications around sensitive situations.
  • Operations & Management: Build and scale ShopMy’s PR function, managing relationships with external PR agencies and leading the hiring of junior talent as necessary.

Your qualifications…

  • Relevant Experience: 8-10+ years in communications, with a specialty in earned media, ideally across agency and in-house roles.
  • Media Relationships: Strong relationships in at least two of these areas: business and trade, creator and technology, or consumer and lifestyle.
  • Editorial Judgment: A strong instinct for what makes a story timely, relevant, and credible.
  • Brand Judgment & Taste: Strong instincts for whether a story is not only timely and relevant, but right for our brand, reflecting what we stand for and the level of taste and cultural credibility we want to be known for.
  • Writing Excellence: An exceptional writer across pitches, executive briefs, quotes, bylines, and social content.
  • Strategic Operator: Able to set strategy while remaining hands-on with pitching, writing, and relationship development.
  • Builder Mindset: Comfortable advising senior leaders and building a communications function from the ground up.
  • Industry Fluency: Experience in technology, fashion, beauty, retail, performance marketing, or the creator economy.

Buscamos un(a) Product Manager con visión estratégica, orientación técnica y fuerte capacidad analítica para liderar el desarrollo de productos basados en inteligencia artificial, especialmente mediante agentes autónomos, LLMs y plataformas de monetización de datos. Este perfil colaborará estrechamente con equipos de desarrollo, ciencia de datos, negocio y desarrollo comercial (BDM), para diseñar soluciones que generen valor real en dominios como contabilidad, finanzas, nómina,

facturación o ecosistemas empresariales. El candidato ideal combinará conocimientos de mercado, experiencia construyendo productos de IA, y habilidades para traducir insights en propuestas viables, rentables y escalables.

Responsabilidades Principales

  • Definir la visión, estrategia y roadmap de productos de IA enfocados en agentes inteligentes, copilots y asistentes embebidos.
  • Analizar tendencias de mercado, competidores, necesidades del cliente y oportunidades de monetización en plataformas basadas en datos.
  • Trabajar junto a Business Development para co-crear propuestas de valor alineadas con necesidades de clientes B2B y B2B2C.
  • Colaborar con equipos técnicos para traducir necesidades de negocio en requerimientos funcionales y prioridades de desarrollo.
  • Identificar e integrar casos de uso viables para IA generativa y agentes en procesos críticos: automatización, recomendación, análisis, interacción.
  • Evaluar y definir modelos de monetización (consumo por API, licenciamiento, data-as-a- service, etc.).
  • Liderar procesos de discovery de producto, validación de hipótesis y entrevistas con usuarios clave.

Requirements

  • 4+ años de experiencia como Product Manager en soluciones tecnológicas o plataformas digitales.
  • Conocimiento sólido del ciclo de vida de productos de IA aplicada a negocio, incluyendo agentes, LLMs, NLP o modelos de recomendación.
  • Experiencia directa colaborando con Business Development o Strategy para definir modelos de ingreso, modelos de negocio, posicionamiento y monetización del producto o servicio.
  • Capacidad para realizar análisis de mercado, segmentación de usuarios y evaluación competitiva en contextos B2B o enterprise.
  • Habilidad para definir requerimientos funcionales claros y comunicarlos a equipos de ingeniería, IA y UX.
  • Experiencia trabajando en equipos ágiles y orientados a OKRs o KPIs.
  • Familiaridad con herramientas de diseño de producto (Jira, Notion, Figma, Miro) y análisis (Looker, Mixpanel, Google Analytics).
  • Inglés fluido a nivel técnico y de negocio.
  • Experiencia Implementando soluciones de IA conversacional con diferentes canales de IM (Whatsapp, Telegram, etc) y experiencia con modelos de pricing con esos canales
  • Experiencia en analisis y estudio de Mercado, estudio de competencia, etc.

Plus / Deseables (Nice to Have)

  • Conocimiento en monetización de datos, licenciamiento de modelos, o marketplaces de data/IA.
  • Experiencia previa en startups o scaleups AI-first.
  • Familiaridad con conceptos como LangChain, RAG, copilots empresariales, agentes autónomos o frameworks como CrewAI, AutoGen.
  • Conocimiento de productos relacionados con ERP, payroll, facturación, contabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Conocimiento básico de modelos de pricing de AI (token-based, tiered usage, performance-based).

Benefits

  • Desarrollo de productos innovadores con enfoque en IA y datos.
  • Cultura de buenas prácticas, arquitectura moderna y trabajo colaborativo.
  • Posibilidades de crecimiento técnico y formación continua.

Toloka AI supports frontier model post-training by building domain-specific reinforcement learning environments, tasks, and evaluation frameworks designed by real practitioners.

Mindrift, powered by Toloka — a leading enterprise AI and machine learning data partner since 2014 — connects top domain experts with cutting-edge AI initiatives. Backed by Toloka’s deep expertise in scalable data generation, crowd technology, and applied ML systems, Mindrift enables experts to shape how next-generation generative models learn, reason, and perform.

We are launching a Management Consulting domain focused on translating real-world consulting engagements into structured learning environments for advanced AI systems. To do this credibly, we are assembling a team of strategy consultants from top-tier firms who can convert authentic project experience into end-to-end examples — from problem structuring and work planning to analysis, synthesis, and client-ready recommendations.

You will join a growing team of consultants from leading strategy firms shaping how AI learns high-level business reasoning.

Important: This role is exclusively for consultants with direct experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm. If you do not have hands-on project experience at one of the firms listed below, please do not apply. This requirement ensures the domain is built by practitioners trained to the highest standards of structured problem-solving and client delivery.

Eligible firms: McKinsey & Company, Boston Consulting Group (BCG), Bain & Company, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Monitor Deloitte (Deloitte S&C), EY-Parthenon, Kearney, and Strategy& (PwC).

Who We’re Looking For

Consultants with 3+ years of experience at one of the firms listed above, with hands-on project experience in:

  • Structuring ambiguous client problems into workable analytical plans
  • Building financial models, market analyses, or synthesized findings from messy inputs
  • Producing client-ready deliverables under time pressure
  • Forming and defending recommendations under uncertainty

No deep technical background is required — we will onboard you on the lightweight tools involved.

What You’ll Do

  • Build realistic consulting project environments — create detailed project scenarios grounded in real engagement dynamics: industry context, financials, constraints, conflicting inputs, and incomplete information.
  • Design structured consulting tasks for AI agents — break projects into discrete tasks that mirror real consulting work: market sizing, commercial due diligence, cost optimization, growth strategy, operational diagnosis, benchmarking, and more.
  • Define evaluation criteria and quality standards — develop grading frameworks, evaluation rubrics, and golden-answer solutions for each task, used to train and calibrate an LLM-based grading system that evaluates AI outputs at scale.

This is a remote, project-based, individual-contributor role focused on analytical design and evaluation.

Skills & Requirements

  • 3+ years at McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Monitor Deloitte, EY-Parthenon, Kearney, or Strategy&
  • Strong structured problem-solving and hypothesis-driven thinking
  • Ability to translate vague problems into clear analytical steps and deliverables
  • High attention to logical consistency and output quality
  • Independent, self-directed working style
  • Clear written English (B2+)

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $60 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 25-30 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS) is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It is the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the first and only to offer dual-platform quantum computing products and services, spanning both annealing and gate-model quantum computing technologies. D-Wave’s mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum today through enterprise-grade systems available on-premises and via its Leap™ quantum cloud service, which offers 99.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations across commercial, government, and research sectors trust D-Wave to address complex computational challenges using quantum computing. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how D-Wave is shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: .

About the role

We have a new opportunity for a Senior DevOps Developer! In this role, you will be on a team of talented DevOps developers working with our Processor Software and Hardware Engineering teams to automate, deploy,monitor, and advance ourstate-of-the-artquantum computing services. Your primary focus will be on the development of our hybrid-cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

You will work as part of the infrastructure team to develop our platform and services, supporting internalapplications hosted within our clustered environments. You will have the opportunity to influence the future of our infrastructure and get full-stack exposure to our high-performance quantum and hybrid computing systems.

What you'll do

  • Design, implement, andoperateour full-stack hybrid cloud, remote, and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Work with our development teams to streamline our build processes and release management via continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • Architect, build, andmaintainhardware-basedCI/CD pipelines
  • Participate in reviews and compliance efforts to ensure we meet the security and performance needs of our growing services through the design and development of security controls, access rules, service configuration,DevOpsbest practices, and testing and monitoring.
  • Respond to operationalincidents and developmentquestionswith the system and perform root-cause analysis.
  • Continuouslymonitorand improve the performance, durability, and reliability of our services.
  • Willingness to join the on-call rotation of development and support staff for off-hourssupport of our services.

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of experience in architecting, configuring, deploying,operating, and troubleshooting modern SaaS/PaaS web applications and environments on cloud and on-premises infrastructure using virtualized systems likeVMware,KVM, orXCP-ng.
  • Intermediate to advanced Linux system administration skills, including troubleshooting and failure analysis, working with logs and systems analysis tools, SSH, certificates, and basic security knowledge.
  • Intermediate to advanced experience with Kubernetes
  • Experienced integrating analytics and monitoring systems such as Grafana,OpenSearch, Influx,Zabbixor Prometheus.
  • Proficiencyprogramming in Python,C (make/clang),Tcl,Ruby, Groovy (Jenkins DSL),or a comparable language including specifically working with 3rd party REST APIs on Linux-based operating systems.

  • A degree in Computing Science, Engineering or equivalent education and experience.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills – you like to document your work!

A D-Waver's DNA

  • We look at the future and say “why not”; we see possibilities where others see problems or routines. We show the way ahead and are committed to achieving ambitious goals.
  • We practice straight talk and listen generously to each other with empathy. We value different opinions and points of views. We ensure that we connect outside as well as inside to learn from others and inspire each other.
  • We hold ourselves accountable for delivering results. We make decisions & take responsibility so that we can act & support each other.
  • As leaders we motivate & engage our teams to undertake beyond what they originally thought possible, by developing our teams & creating the conditions for people to grow and empower themselves through enabling & coaching.

Our Compensation Philosophy is Simple but Powerful:

We believe providing D-Wavers with company ownership, competitive pay, and a range of meaningful benefits is the start of creating a culture where people want to give the best they’ve got — not because they’re simply making money, but because they’ve fallen in love with our vision, mission, values, and team.

During the interview process, your Recruiter will review our total rewards (base, equity, bonus, perks, benefit, culture) offerings. The final offer is determined by your proficiencies within this level.

We celebrate diverse perspectives to drive innovation in our pursuit. Our employees range from distinguished domain experts with decades of experience in their respective fields, to bright and motivated graduates eager to make their mark. Our diverse and innovative team will make you feel appreciated, supported and empower your career growth at D-Wave.

raw.excerpt: OverviewNakupuna Federal is seeking a Senior Business/Functional Analyst to join our team of talented consultants providing Contractor Support Services (CSS) to the Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) Business Systems Center (BSC).
raw.description:
Overview

Nakupuna Federal is seeking a Senior Business/Functional Analyst to join our team of talented consultants providing Contractor Support Services (CSS) to the Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) Business Systems Center (BSC). Support under this contract includes technical services supporting application development efforts to modernize NAVSUP supply and logistics applications and manage associated technical debt. The Senior Business/Functional Analyst will provide functional and business analysis expertise throughout the software development lifecycle and work closely with Government and contractor team members in an Agile delivery environment.

Responsibilities

The following reflects management's definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons:

  • Provide functional knowledge and subject matter expertise for assigned applications and perform assigned application support activities.
  • Elicit, analyze, document, validate, and maintain business and functional requirements obtained from customers, users, and other stakeholders.
  • Create, update, and maintain work items in the Enterprise Platform, currently AzDO, ensuring activities and supporting information are accurately documented and kept current within five business days.
  • Work with the Government PO/PM to decompose requirements and stories into work that can reasonably be completed within a sprint, generally within 10–15 business days and assist in defining Acceptance Criteria and the sprint Definition of Done.
  • Identify and document the tasks required to successfully complete Product Backlog Items (PBIs) in AzDO.
  • Develop PBI estimates and project roadmaps in support of project requirements, priorities, and schedules.
  • Establish and maintain traceability and dependencies between requirements, including Epics, Features, PBIs, Stories, Tasks, and associated systems, within AzDO.
  • Work closely with the Government to continually maintain the Product Backlog in alignment with the Agile cadence, ensuring necessary Release and Sprint Backlog items are defined with Acceptance Criteria and available for Government prioritization before the start of each release and sprint.
  • Support development priorities in accordance with the Program Backlog.
  • Adhere to Scrum best practices and participate in recommended Scrum Events and Artifacts in accordance with the 2020 Scrum Guide, Agile Kanban practices, or other Agile or Scrum practices approved by the Government PO.
  • Effectively facilitate and participate in Scrum and Agile events and practices.
  • Support the full range of System/Software Development Lifecycle activities, including requirements, analysis, design, development, testing, security, and deployment.
  • Coordinate analysis, design, development, testing, and deployment activities necessary to complete assigned stories in accordance with Acceptance Criteria and the Definition of Done.
  • Propose Minimum Viable Product (MVP) solutions that provide an initial capability to end users while enabling user feedback to influence future development sprints.
  • Develop documentation in accordance with Agile Scrum best practices and the NAVSUP BSC Service Delivery Model.
  • Identify, define, or modify interfaces with other systems and applications and ensure agreements with interfacing systems/applications are formally documented.
  • Analyze system requirements and translate functional designs into detailed logic sufficient to support coding of assigned software systems, modules, and components.
  • Review individual modules and overall system designs for validity, including validation of record input, data elements, and output reports.
  • Perform required testing based on established Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done to verify software and system quality and functionality.
  • Prepare release packages for Government approval.
  • Provide pre-implementation training resources to customers and users.
  • Support the resolution of Production Outages.
  • Work with the Government PO/PM and SM to define and deliver metrics supporting project objectives. Metrics may include release burnup, sprint burndown, planned versus accepted PBI estimates, escaped defects, velocity, and other evolving measures, with a maximum of 10 metrics per team.
  • Provide comprehensive application Transfer of Knowledge to NAVSUP BSC application team personnel through concise, shop-usable lesson plans and other appropriate knowledge-transfer activities.
  • Actively provide daily mentoring to Government team members while performing assigned activities to increase Government personnel knowledge and familiarity with analyst tasks and support independent performance of similar future activities.
  • Support documentation of mentoring and knowledge-transfer activities for inclusion in monthly progress reports.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess strong business and functional analysis capabilities and have experience operating as part of an Agile application development team. Specifically, the candidate should possess the following knowledge, skills, and abilities:

  • Demonstrated ability to elicit, document, analyze, and validate business and functional requirements.
  • Knowledge and practical experience with Agile concepts, principles, practices, and team-based delivery.
  • Proficiency with data analysis tools and techniques, including SQL and Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to analyze data and derive meaningful insights.
  • Ability to identify, analyze, and assist in resolving complex business and functional problems.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, users, technical personnel, Government stakeholders, and team members at varying organizational levels.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and completeness in requirements, work items, and supporting documentation.
  • Ability to adapt to changing business needs, priorities, requirements, and Agile delivery schedules.
  • Ability to establish effective working relationships and collaborate successfully within cross-functional Government and contractor teams.
  • Knowledge of business processes, applicable industry trends, and business analysis best practices.
  • Ability to think strategically and align proposed business and functional solutions with organizational and program goals.
  • Prior DoN or DoW information technology experience is a plus.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must be able to successfully complete the background investigation required for a Public Trust position.

Experience: Minimum of three (3) years of experience with Agile concepts and principles and experience participating as a member of Agile teams. Minimum of five (5) years of experience eliciting, documenting, and validating business requirements.

Education: Minimum of two (2) years of college/work experience, in accordance with contract requirements

Location: Remote position. Minimal travel may be required at the client's request.

Physical Requirements: The ideal candidate must at a minimum be able to meet the following physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation:

  • Ability to perform repetitive motions with the hands, wrists, and fingers.
  • Ability to engage in and follow audible communications in emergency situations.
  • Ability to sit for prolonged periods at a desk and working on a computer.

The Nakupuna Companies use a market-based compensation strategy to ensure that our employees are compensated within applicable market ranges commensurate with multiple factors, including but not limited to the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability, organizational requirements, and position location. The projected compensation range for this position is $115,000 to $130,000 (annualized USD). The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Nakupuna Companies' total compensation package for employees.

  • Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve end-user issues related to Salesforce CRM functionality
  • Perform administrative tasks including product catalog updates, user provisioning, permission set assignments, and account access resolution
  • Redirect irrelevant cases and create tickets for valid requests requiring further action
  • Make routine record changes and data corrections within the platform

raw.description:
About Tailscale

Tailscale is building the new Internet by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer to join our growing team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

  • Develop the Tailscale product, contributing to client code and backend services. The client code is a mix of C#, XAML, and Go. Prior Go expertise is not a requirement.
  • Bring a special focus on our Windows platform, building and maintaining our Windows client using the modern WinUI/Windows App SDK stack, while contributing to common code that supports macOS, mobile, and other core client platforms.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with engineers on a native Windows desktop client using Windows App SDK, WinUI, C#, XAML and Go
  • Implement support for the latest Windows platform features while maintaining compatibility with a subset of older versions
  • Develop and optimize product features on Windows, with a focus on UI components and platform integration
  • Develop and maintain unit and integration tests using Microsoft Testing Platform v2 and xUnit
  • Contribute to common, cross-platform Tailscale code

What We Are Looking For

  • Four or more years of experience in software development
  • Strong understanding of software development principles, capabilities, and limitations of the Windows platform
  • Proficiency in C# and modern native UI frameworks (WinUI/UWP/WPF)
  • Experience with general networking concepts - DNS, VPNs, IP Networking, routing, etc.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to give and process constructive feedback, as well as work independently
  • Flexibility to adjust to the dynamic nature of a startup

Nice to Have

  • Experience with WinUI 3 and Windows App SDK
  • Experience developing native Windows applications and services
  • Familiarity with Windows networking stack and Windows Filtering Platform
  • Familiarity with Windows security model, session isolation, access tokens and related concepts
  • Proficiency in Go

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

CAN Pay Range
$191,620—$239,860 CAD

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge.

As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals.

Our Company Values:

  • Genuinely Caring:We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention.
  • Empowering You:We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions.
  • Innovation and Improvement:We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.
  • Earning Your Trust:We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.

Job Summary

Ziply Fiber is building one of the most technically advanced fiber-first broadband networks in the Pacific Northwest, and we're moving fast. As Vice President of Network Architecture & Engineering, you will serve as the chief technical authority for our full network stack — access, voice, subscriber edge, IP core, transport, and infrastructure. You will lead a team of Principal Architects and Directors, own the multi-year technology roadmap, and drive the transformation programs that reduce cost, accelerate deployment, and position Ziply for competitive leadership in every market we enter.

This is an executive role that demands equal command of technical depth and business impact. You will build the business cases, secure the investments, and deliver the results — measured in dollars saved, deployment velocity accelerated, and operational dependencies eliminated.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.

Network Architecture Strategy & Transformation

·Define and own the multi-year network architecture roadmap across voice, access, subscriber edge, IP core & metro, transport, and infrastructure domains.

·Drive technology transformation programs: legacy platform exits, vendor-agnostic architecture adoption, zero-touch provisioning, and network automation.

Leadership & Organizational Capability

·Lead and scale a team of Principal Architects and Directors; build organizational capability through director- and principal-level hiring and development.

·Represent the technology organization in executive-level discussions, board briefings, and strategic partnership negotiations.

·Set clear objectives, success metrics, and accountability for architecture and engineering leaders; coach teams through complex technical, financial, and organizational tradeoffs.

·Develop succession depth and leadership bench strength for critical architecture and engineering functions.

Business Case, Investment & Financial Planning

·Develop and own business cases for major network investments — quantifying cost savings, stranded asset recovery, and competitive positioning for executive and board approval.

·Deliver measurable cost reductions through optics standardization, technology consolidation (DACS, legacy platforms), and operational independence from TSA and vendor lock-in agreements.

·Collaborate with the Enterprise Delivery Office on CapEx and OpEx planning for all network engineering initiatives.

Technology Certification, Vendor Strategy & Selection

·Establish and operate a technology certification program: device qualification, PoC lab management, vendor-donated equipment programs, and accelerated certification cycles.

·Own vendor and technology selection: RFPs, PoCs, architecture reviews, and contract negotiations across the network stack.

Cross-Functional Operations & Execution

·Partner with Network Planning, Platform Ops, IT/Platform Technology, and NOC to ensure architecture enables operational efficiency and autonomous network operations.

Other Duties

·Performs other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization.

Required Qualifications:

·High school diploma or GED.

·Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.

·15+ years of progressive network engineering and architecture experience, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role at a broadband ISP, CLEC, or telco.

·Proven track record of delivering large-scale network transformation programs with quantifiable business impact — cost savings, asset recovery, or competitive differentiation measured in the tens to hundreds of millions.

·Experience scaling high-performance architecture or engineering teams; demonstrated ability to add director- and principal-level talent to strengthen organizational capability.

·Hands-on experience with transport (400G/100G), fiber voice/VoIP business cases, and CPE/modem platform migrations at scale.

·Deep familiarity with zero-touch provisioning, vendor-agnostic orchestration, and network automation platforms.

·Experience exiting legacy technology dependencies: TSA agreements, end-of-life platforms (DACS, TDM, legacy ACS), and third-party operational agreements.

·Strong business acumen: ability to build, defend, and deliver on multi-million-dollar investment cases at the executive level.

·Excellent cross-functional leadership: able to align engineering, operations, finance, and vendor partners around shared outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications:

·Advanced degree such as MS, MBA, or equivalent executive-level business or technical education.

·Experience establishing or operating a technology lab or architecture center (vendor certification, PoC environments, donated equipment programs).

·Background in digital transformation or operations modernization — omni-channel, automation, AI-assisted operations, or field technician tooling.

·Intellectual property, publication, patent, or industry thought-leadership experience in networking, automation, platform modernization, or subscriber experience domains.

·Prior experience at a fiber-first or fiber-overbuilder ISP in a competitive broadband market.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

·Ability to work independently and apply sound judgment and reasoning skills to a variety of situations.

·Ability to multi-task and collaborate effectively with other personnel to meet deadlines.

·Strong verbal and written communication, attention to detail, and organizational skills.

·Ability to work within critical deadlines.

·Ability to adjust to rapidly changing priorities and schedules.

·Ability to provide excellent customer service.

·Executive presence with the ability to influence across Technology, Operations, Finance, Legal, Product, and executive leadership.

·Strong analytical, financial, and decision-making skills with the ability to balance technical excellence, customer impact, operational risk, and business value.

·Ability to build trust, lead through ambiguity, and drive alignment in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US for any employer. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential and marginal functions may require maintaining physical condition necessary for bending, stooping, sitting, walking, or standing for prolonged periods of time; most of time is spent sitting in a comfortable position with frequent opportunity to move about. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

Work is performed in an office setting with exposure to computer screens and requires extensive use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and multi-line telephone system. The work is primarily a modern office setting.

At all times, Ziply Fiber must be your primary employer. Unless otherwise prohibited by law, employees may not hold outside employment nor be self-employed without obtaining approval in writing from Ziply Fiber. In holding outside employment or self-employment, employees should ensure that participation does not conflict with responsibilities to Ziply Fiber or its business interests.

Diverse Workforce / EEO:

Ziply Fiber is an equal opportunity employer. Ziply Fiber will consider all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, and the presence of a non-job-related handicap or disability or any other legally protected status.

Ziply Fiber requires a pre-employment background check as conditions of employment. Ziply Fiber may require a pre-employment drug screening.

Ziply Fiber is a drug free workplace.

raw.description:
United We Dream (UWD) is the largest immigrant youth-led community in the country. We create welcoming spaces for young people – regardless of immigration status – to support, engage, and empower them to make their voice heard and win!

With an online reach of over 2 million, more than 500,000 members as well as over 100 local groups, UWD is made up of fearless youth fighting to improve the lives of our members and their families. Our vision is a society which celebrates our diversity and believes in a multi-ethnic, intersectional path to getting there.

Whether we’re organizing in the streets, providing immigration services, building innovative technology systems, opening doors for LGBTQ immigrant youth, clearing pathways to education, stopping deportations or creating alliances across social movements, United We Dream puts undocumented immigrant youth in the driver’s seat. UWD is a fast paced, dynamic

organization which has become a leading voice in social change and has appeared in every major news outlet in the country.

We are driven by the priorities and needs of our members; have trained thousands of individuals; and have supported countless local organizing groups. Our grassroots-driven approach has a proven record of success and we’re looking for talented folks to join our team!

POSITION SUMMARY

The Leading the Dream Campaign Fellowship is a fellowship program for college students (sophomores, juniors, and seniors) who are passionate about social justice and energized to advocate for change in their communities. The program will provide fellows with training, coaching, and hands-on experience to grow their skills as organizers and leaders. Fellows will also have the opportunity to become part of a community of like-minded youth advocates and to become a part of the United We Dream Network. Fellows will be expected to fully engage with the training curriculum to build up their campaign and advocacy skills and to complete a set of assignments putting those skills into action. This is a remote, part-time position.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Participate in weekly workshops throughout the 10 weeks of the program to grow your critical thinking skills, develop key campaign and organizing skills, and deepen your understanding of social justice advocacy and transformation.
  • Build relationships with UWD members, student organizations and local interest groups, forging strategic partnerships to amplify the visibility of member campaigns and mobilize collective action.
  • Participate in recurring trainings, meetings, check-ins, and one-on-ones with UWD staff, members, and partners to build and strengthen relationships, complete assignments as needed, and put your campaign skills into practice.
  • Create trainings, presentations, method guides, reports, and other written materials as needed to train and build up the organizing capacity of diverse audiences, such as UWD members, staff, partner groups, and others.
  • Provide coaching to UWD member-students and support them through identifying issue-based campaigns, the decision-makers that can address their problems, potential allies to recruit, and a set of tactics to push forward their demands.
  • Complete assignments aimed at broadening your understanding of culture, politics and power, and exercises to place your campaign skills into practice in the real world.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • Deeply committed to United We Dream’s mission and an ability to balance your burning passion for justice with a good sense of humor
  • Experience with writing and briefing reports
  • Excellent communication skills (written, oral, and interpersonal skills)
  • Enjoys working with others and is a team player with the ability to integrate data and insights from, individuals and teams across various departments
  • Ability to analyze and draw insights from data to synthesize and present the most important insights to senior-level and non-data people in an easy-to-understand way
  • Impeccable attention to detail; able to spot mistakes and inconsistencies missed by others
  • Experience with Microsoft Office and/or Google G-Suite applications, especially for analysis and presentation of data

CULTURAL COMPETENCY (MUST HAVES)

  • Strong understanding of the immigrant experience
  • Understanding of race, gender, sexuality and other aspects of identity, and their intersections, and how that plays out in the work
  • Demonstrates self-awareness of their own multiple group identities and their attendant dynamics, and can adapt approach as needed
  • Ability to build strong relationships and trust across race, gender, class, and other group identities, both internally and externally

SALARY AND BENEFITS

Compensation: Commensurate with experience. United We Dream offers a competitive salary, and comprehensive benefits package including paid vacation, health insurance, retirement plans, and life insurance.

Base pay ranges $25.00 per hour with a max of 15 hours per week.

Location: As UWD is a remote-first workplace, this is a part-time position. We have a preference to hire in states where we already have employees working from home - AZ, DC, CT, CA, FL, IL, MO, NJ, NM, NY, OK, SC, and TX. Once UWD determines it is safe to do so, you may be required to travel occasionally to DC or elsewhere, for internal team meetings, retreats, and UWD events as required for your role.

TO APPLY

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. Edit: Please submit a resume, cover letter, through our career website . Please do not send duplicate materials and incomplete applications will not be considered. No phone calls, please.

###

UWD is an equal opportunity employer; people of color and individuals from diverse backgrounds are encouraged to apply. UWD does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.

  • Own the underwriting direction, risk appetite, and portfolio composition of the E&S Property (Primary & Excess) book across all target classes, including manufacturers, industrial, vacant, hospitality, healthcare, mercantile, and real estate schedules

  • Set and enforce underwriting standards, pricing guidelines, and coverage parameters consistent with the book's profitability objectives

  • Lead complex and large-account underwriting decisions; serve as the technical authority and escalation point for the team

  • Maintain a disciplined approach to accumulation management, ensuring adherence to CAT exclusions (no Tier 1 Wind, Flood, or EQ/EQSL)

  • Drive use of underwriting indications to enable broker partners to set accurate client expectations and accelerate decisioning

Portfolio Management & Profitability

  • Monitor and actively manage loss ratios, combined ratios, and portfolio trends; take corrective action when segments underperform

  • Partner with actuarial and finance on pricing adequacy, rate monitoring, and reserving inputs

  • Analyze submission flow, hit ratios, and renewal retention to identify where the book is growing well and where it needs tightening

  • Balance profitable growth with underwriting discipline — new premium is only valuable if it performs

Team Management & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10 property underwriters across experience levels

  • Establish clear performance expectations, accountability frameworks, and a culture of continuous improvement

  • Recruit and retain underwriting talent; build bench strength for future growth

  • Foster a team environment that rewards technical rigor, sound judgment, and broker responsiveness

Wholesale Distribution

  • Cultivate and deepen relationships with key wholesale broker partners; serve as a senior point of contact for strategic accounts

  • Collaborate with production and distribution leadership to identify appetite gaps and market opportunities

  • Represent Skyward at industry events, broker meetings, and wholesale market forums

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with claims, actuarial, legal, and product teams to ensure the book is supported end-to-end

  • Provide market and competitive intelligence to inform product development and pricing strategy

  • Partner with technology and operations to improve submission handling, data quality, and underwriting workflow efficiency

Experience

  • 10+ years of E&S or specialty property underwriting experience, with meaningful time in a wholesale/non-admitted environment

  • Prior leadership experience managing underwriting teams; comfort operating as both a strategic leader and technical contributor

  • Demonstrated track record of building or managing a profitable property book across a broad range of commercial classes

Technical Skills

  • Deep knowledge of commercial property underwriting, including COPE analysis, rate-on-line assessment, and coverage structure

  • Familiarity with layered property structures (ground-up, primary, quota share, and excess)

  • Working knowledge of ISO and proprietary property forms

  • Proficiency in evaluating equipment breakdown, property enhancement, and schedule risks

  • Strong understanding of CAT modeling concepts and accumulation management principles

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Strong communicator and relationship builder — credible with both wholesale brokers and internal executive stakeholders

  • Data-driven decision-maker with the ability to translate portfolio analytics into actionable strategy

  • High accountability orientation; comfortable owning results and making hard calls on underperforming segments

  • Collaborative and team-oriented, with the ability to develop talent and build a high-performance culture

Compensation & Benefits

The applicable base salary for this opportunity is $235,000 - $270,000. The base pay offered will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. In addition to the base salary, this opportunity may be eligible for performance-based incentives.​ We are excited to offer a competitive total rewards package which includes health and welfare benefits, tuition and professional certification assistance, 401k savings, elective participation in the Employee Stock Purchase Program, paid time off, paid holidays, and child bonding leave, as well as other employee assistance.

raw.description:
Video Editor (Adobe Premiere, Social Media & Marketing Content) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours, with flexibility for launches, campaigns, and deadlines

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring a Video Editor for one of our clients to create engaging, polished, and performance-driven video content across social media, marketing campaigns, paid advertising, websites, and internal communications.

This is more than a technical editing role. You’ll be responsible for turning raw footage into compelling stories designed to capture attention, increase watch time, improve audience retention, and strengthen campaign performance.

You’ll create and optimize content across platforms including TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, LinkedIn, websites, and paid advertising channels.

If you understand how editing pace, storytelling, hooks, visuals, and platform-specific formats influence content performance, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Video Editing & Content Creation

  • Edit raw footage into polished, engaging, and professional videos.
  • Create both short-form and long-form content.
  • Work with editing platforms such as:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Final Cut Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
  • Build edits around strong storytelling, pacing, and audience attention.
  • Create compelling openings and maintain viewer interest throughout each video.
  • Align every edit with brand guidelines, campaign objectives, and marketing goals.
  • Adapt editing styles based on platform, audience, and content purpose.

Social Media & Platform Optimization

  • Create platform-native video content for:
    • TikTok
    • Instagram Reels
    • YouTube & YouTube Shorts
    • LinkedIn
    • Websites
    • Paid advertising campaigns
  • Adapt content into multiple aspect ratios, including:
    • 16:9
    • 9:16
    • 1:1
  • Repurpose footage into multiple pieces of content without making each version feel repetitive.
  • Optimize exports for the appropriate combination of quality, file size, and platform requirements.
  • Understand how editing styles differ between short-form social content, long-form video, and advertising creative.

Motion Graphics & Visual Enhancements

  • Add professional:
    • Captions
    • Titles
    • Lower thirds
    • Motion graphics
    • Transitions
    • Visual overlays
  • Use tools such as Adobe After Effects and Canva when appropriate.
  • Maintain consistent typography, visual language, and brand presentation.
  • Enhance videos without over-editing or distracting from the core message.

Audio & Color

  • Clean and balance audio for professional output.
  • Improve dialogue clarity and reduce unwanted background noise.
  • Handle audio syncing and volume leveling.
  • Add appropriate licensed music and sound effects.
  • Perform color correction and grading.
  • Maintain visual consistency between different cameras, clips, and environments.

Footage & Project Management

  • Import, organize, and maintain raw footage and creative assets.
  • Keep project files and folder structures clean and consistent.
  • Maintain clear version control throughout revision cycles.
  • Archive completed projects so footage and assets can be easily retrieved and repurposed.
  • Manage multiple editing projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Collaboration & Revisions

  • Work closely with:
    • Marketing teams
    • Content strategists
    • Creative teams
  • Receive and manage feedback through tools such as Frame.io and shared review systems.
  • Turn revisions around quickly while maintaining quality.
  • Communicate clearly about timelines, creative requirements, and deliverables.
  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback without losing consistency or creative direction.

Performance Optimization

  • Review content performance metrics including:
    • Watch time
    • Audience retention
    • Engagement
    • CTR
  • Identify patterns in high- and low-performing content.
  • Apply performance insights to future edits.
  • Collaborate with marketing teams to test new hooks, formats, pacing, and creative approaches.
  • Continuously improve editing decisions based on actual audience behavior.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You understand that great video editing is about storytelling and attention, not just transitions and effects.
  • You know how to make the opening seconds of a video count.
  • You can edit both short-form and long-form content effectively.
  • You understand how content consumption differs across TikTok, Reels, YouTube, LinkedIn, and paid ads.
  • You can execute quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • You’re highly organized and comfortable managing multiple projects.
  • You take ownership of your work from raw footage through final export.
  • You’re receptive to feedback and can handle revision cycles professionally.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional video editing experience.
  • Strong proficiency with one or more of:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Final Cut Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
  • Experience editing social media and marketing content.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Video pacing
    • Storytelling
    • Viewer retention
    • Platform-specific content
  • Experience with:
    • Audio cleanup and syncing
    • Color correction
    • Captions and graphics
    • Multi-platform formatting
    • Platform-specific exports
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating professional video editing work.

Preferred Experience

  • Adobe After Effects and motion graphics experience.
  • Experience editing:
    • Paid advertising creatives
    • UGC-style videos
    • Performance marketing content
    • Short-form social content
    • Long-form YouTube content
  • Familiarity with performance metrics such as:
    • Watch time
    • Audience retention
    • CTR
    • Engagement
  • Experience using Frame.io or similar creative review platforms.
  • Background supporting:
    • SaaS companies
    • E-commerce brands
    • Marketing agencies
    • Media companies

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Video Editor’s day revolves around turning raw footage into content people actually want to watch. You will:

  • Review and organize incoming footage and creative briefs.
  • Edit short-form and long-form videos.
  • Create social media and marketing campaign content.
  • Add captions, graphics, transitions, and sound design.
  • Perform audio cleanup and color correction.
  • Create platform-specific versions and exports.
  • Review feedback and complete revisions.
  • Analyze content performance to improve future edits.
  • Archive completed projects and maintain organized creative files.

In short: you transform raw footage into polished, platform-native video content that captures attention, tells a compelling story, and drives measurable engagement.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery of video projects.
  • Strong audience watch time and retention.
  • Improved engagement across video content.
  • Consistent brand quality across platforms.
  • Reduced and efficient revision cycles.
  • Accurate platform-specific formatting and delivery.
  • Organized, scalable project and asset management.
  • Positive feedback from marketing and creative stakeholders.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership over creative output.
  • Direct impact on marketing and content performance.
  • Opportunity to create content across multiple platforms and formats.
  • Exposure to organic social, paid advertising, and brand content.
  • Performance-driven environment where creative decisions can be measured.
  • Fully remote collaboration with U.S.-based teams.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Video Editor
    • Creative Lead
    • Senior Content Producer
    • Content Director

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Portfolio Review + Practical Editing Task
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you:

  • Love video editing and visual storytelling
  • Understand Adobe Premiere Pro and modern editing workflows
  • Know what makes social media content engaging
  • Can edit for both short-form and long-form formats
  • Understand pacing, hooks, watch time, and audience retention
  • Thrive in a fast-moving creative environment

We’d love to see your work.

Apply today with your portfolio or video editing reel and help create content that captures attention, strengthens brands, and drives performance.

Business Area:

Product Mgmt.

Seniority Level:

Job Description:

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

As a designer at Cloudera your main focus is to let your curiosity drive you. You will use your passion and knowledge to create precision-crafted designs that bring simplicity and innovation to our products and services. The Cloudera Platform helps customers manage the lifecycle of their data, from the edge to AI. Our hybrid data platform delivers unprecedented value to our customers and is key to our overall strategy and success. We need an experienced and talented designer to drive enterprise ready improvements and cross cutting product design initiatives related to the Cloudera Platform.

You will be leading the full user-centered design process, from user interviews, competitor analysis, high fidelity interface designs, prototypes, feature validation, and working with engineering to uphold the quality of implementation. All while partnering closely with other designers and your product triad to deliver the most usable solutions possible. Additionally, you will work closely with the entire design team to improve our process, our design system, and our design culture. The culture of the Cloudera Design team is human first, we actively seek to grow each member’s career through outside education and candid, compassionate feedback from other experienced designers.

As a Lead UX Designer you will:

  • Design user flows, diagrams, wireframes, and designs to satisfy product requirements and follow product design standards.

  • Create high-fidelity visual designs and/or prototypes that demonstrate user flows.

  • Deliver design specifications and supporting assets to the development teams.

  • Participate in design reviews to collect feedback from designers and stakeholders.

  • Facilitate collaborative workshops that unlock innovation.

  • Be the champion of the Product Triad to inspire meaningful collaboration to help your team realize their best work possible

  • Iterate on existing application features to improve usability and drive key metrics.

  • Assist in the planning and estimating of design activities, participating in broader workflow coordination and setting of expectations.

  • Conduct product research and usability studies.

  • Dive deep into domain research, understanding the customers and the technology.

  • Conduct competitive analysis of other products and services.

  • Contribute to and maintain design pattern libraries.

  • Provide mentorship and guidance to other members of the design team.

We are excited if you have (Required Experience):

  • 6+ years of professional experience in UX design, UI design, product design, and/or web

  • Self-starter with excellent time management skills and ability to handle multiple projects with shifting priorities.

  • Portfolio exhibiting the ability to conceptualize and demonstrate visual communication skills. Examples of process and design approaches are highly recommended.

  • Strong understanding of user centered design processes and methodology, particularly as applied to enterprise software, PAAS, and on-prem applications.

  • Mastery of design principles with a firm understanding of grid systems, typography, and color.

  • A strong attention to detail and consistency in design.

  • Experience in coordinating and conducting qualitative and quantitative research, including usability studies, discovery interviews, and product analytics data analysis.

  • Strong collaborator experienced in working with cross-functional, international teams.

  • Demonstrable systems thinking skills.

  • Proficient in Figma, Figma Make, Zeplin, and relevant AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field required or equivalent experience.

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required.

  • Experience working with cloud, on-prem and hybrid data platforms, or other similar technologies.

You might also have:

  • Strong opinions & curiosity of AI & Design, along with your own experiments, workflows and AI x design processes.

  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, front-end javascript frameworks, and mobile centric design patterns.

  • Experience designing for data streaming, data engineering, data warehousing, machine learning and AI applications.

This is a full-time contract role.

The anticipated hourly range for this position is: 65.00-70.00/HR

Individual compensation within the published range is determined by the candidate's skills, experience, qualifications, and primary work location. In addition to base pay, sales roles are eligible for Cloudera's commission plan, while non-sales roles are eligible for the corporate incentive plan. All employees receive a comprehensive benefits package.
