raw.description:
About Us

Community health is about more than just vaccines and checkups. It’s about giving people the resources they need to live their best lives. At Neighborhood, this is our vision. A community where everyone is healthy and happy. We’re with you every step of the way, with the care you need for each of life’s chapters. At Neighborhood, we are Better Together.

As a private, non-profit 501(C) (3) community health organization, we serve over 500,000 medical, dental, and behavioral health visits from more than 96k people annually. We do this in pursuit of our mission to improve the health and happiness of the communities we serve by providing quality care to all, regardless of situation or circumstance.

We have been doing this since 1969, and it is our employees that make this mission a reality. Regardless of the role, our team focuses on being compassionate, having integrity, being professional, always collaborating, and consistently going above and beyond. If that sounds like an organization you want to be a part of, we would love to have you.

*Schedule: Monday - Friday from 8:00 am-5:00 pm. This is a Temporary Remote/Work from Home assignment, with an anticipated end date of 10/31/2026.

ROLE OVERVIEW and PURPOSE

The Telehealth Registered Nurse will work to support the mission and vision of Neighborhood Healthcare by providing excellent patient-centered care and services within a dynamic team environment. This role will triage patients by evaluating and assessing their responses to determine care options. Additionally, this role will refer patients to a provider or recommend other treatment plans.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Answers patient calls on a wide range of healthcare topics during normal clinic hours
  • Assesses patients understanding of their condition and identify potential care and/or provider gaps
  • Evaluates, assesses, and triages immediate health concerns and documents outcomes; including determining if the concern requires emergency care or an appointment to see a provider
  • Searches a database of conditions and treatments for patients

Clinical Administration:

  • Provides patient advice and education on handling their situation
  • Provides ongoing training and support to Call Center Representatives (CCR) and others to assure effective and appropriate patient services through the Call Center

Patient Education:

  • Serves as a clinical resource to the Call Center and across the continuum of care to influence organizational standards related to patient safety and care delivery
  • Serves as a resource for patients by providing education and guidance to support positive health outcomes
  • Initiate patient education plan according to individualized needs, including patient and family instructions
  • Educates and instructs patients regarding lab tests, results, medication functions, and expectations to gain cooperation and allay apprehension

Customer Relations:

  • Maintains professional working relationships with all levels of staff, clients, and the public
  • Cooperate in accomplishing department goals and objectives

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

  • Associate's degree in nursing required; Bachelor's degree in nursing preferred
  • CA RN license required
  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification through an American Heart Association (AHA)-approved source is required upon hire and must be maintained as a condition of employment.
    • AHA-approved courses include an in-person, hands-on skills check with a certified instructor using a mannequin to demonstrate CPR and emergency response techniques.
    • Online-only BLS courses without a live skills check do not meet this requirement.
  • Three years’ nursing experience; nursing telephone assessment and triage experience preferred
  • Valid CA driver’s license or out of state driver’s license for active military personnel/spouses required
  • Proof of auto insurance required
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred

ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS (Knowledge, Skills and Abilities)

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including superior composition, typing and proofreading skills
  • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form
  • Knowledgeable about and experience with assessing and solving problems on the telephone
  • Ability to use Microsoft Office applications
  • Ability to successfully manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Excellent planning and organizational ability
  • Ability to work as part of a team as well as independently
  • Ability to work with highly confidential information in a professional and ethical manner

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift/carry 10 lbs/weight
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time

COMPLIANCE (Safety & HIPPA)

  • Follows all safety procedures as outlined in Neighborhood Healthcare’s Illness and Injury Prevention Plan (IIPP) and report any injuries and/or unsafe conditions immediately
  • Maintains current knowledge of policies and procedures as they relate to safe work practices
  • Follows all safety procedures and report unsafe conditions
  • Uses appropriate body mechanics to ensure an injury free environment
  • Familiarity with location of nearest fire extinguisher and emergency exits
  • Follows all infection control procedures including blood-borne pathogen protocols
  • Maintains privacy of all patients, employee and volunteer information and access such information only on a need-to-know basis for business purposes
  • Complies with all regulations regarding corporate integrity and security obligations
  • Reports all behavior and/or activity that are unethical, fraudulent, or unlawful

Neighborhood Healthcare offers a generous benefit plan that includes: Partially company paid Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans. Two plus weeks of vacation, Nine Holidays including two Floating Holidays of your choosing, Sick/Personal time, Volunteer Time Off (VTO), 403b Retirement plan (similar to a 401k), optional Health and Wellness events, and much more!

Pay range: $50.09 to $75.09 an hour, depending on experience and additional qualifications.

Compensation Disclosure: The posted salary range reflects the designated pay grade for this position. While this range represents the broader classification of the role, actual compensation will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s overall knowledge, skills, and experience, market data and industry benchmarks, internal equity within the organization, Budgetary considerations and organizational needs. As a result, placement within the range is not guaranteed, and the full pay grade range may not be utilized.

Category: Architecture & Construction

Location:


PERMANENT AU DAYSHIFT, REMOTE/WFH PHILIPPINES
Job Title: Steel Estimator (with Pricing) 30-40 HOURS PER WEEK
VA RATE : $12-14 AUD per hour (negotiable)

Job Summary
The Steel Estimator is responsible for preparing accurate material take-offs, cost estimates, and pricing for structural and miscellaneous steel projects. This role supports sales, project management, and fabrication teams by providing competitive and profitable pricing aligned with project specifications and industry standards.

Key Responsibilities
Estimating & Take-Offs
  • Review construction drawings, specifications, and tender documents
  • Perform detailed quantity take-offs for structural and miscellaneous steel (beams, columns, plates, stairs, handrails, etc.)
  • Identify scope inclusions, exclusions, and potential risks
  • Clarify discrepancies in drawings and specifications

Pricing & Costing
  • Prepare accurate pricing for materials, fabrication, labor, coatings, transport, and erection
  • Obtain and analyze supplier and subcontractor quotes
  • Apply labor rates, overheads, margins, and contingency allowances
  • Develop competitive bid pricing while maintaining profitability
  • Update and maintain pricing databases and rate libraries

Tender & Proposal Support
  • Prepare detailed estimates, summaries, and tender submissions
  • Assist in value engineering and alternative pricing options
  • Support negotiations and post-tender clarifications
  • Coordinate with sales, engineers, and project managers

Documentation & Reporting
  • Produce estimate breakdowns, BOQs, and pricing schedules
  • Maintain accurate estimating records for audit and reference
  • Track historical project costs to improve future estimates

Compliance & Standards
  • Ensure estimates comply with relevant building codes, project specifications, and client
requirements
  • Follow company estimating procedures and quality standards
Required Skills & Qualifications
  • Proven experience as a Steel Estimator or Construction Estimator. Minimum of 5-8 years.
  • Strong knowledge of structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication
  • Proficiency in estimating software (e.g., Bluebeam, Tekla, AutoDesk, or similar)
  • Advanced Excel skills for pricing and cost analysis
  • Ability to read and interpret Architectural / structural drawings
  • Strong attention to detail and analytical skills
  • Excellent communication and time management skills

raw.description:
Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Estimator (Kitchens & Joinery)

Compensation range: $1,800 AUD - $2,400 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: They are a family-run Australian business specialising in custom kitchens, cabinetry and joinery for residential and commercial projects. They are a hands-on and practical team with a strong focus on quality craftsmanship, accuracy and getting the details right from the start. They work closely together to keep projects organised, quotes accurate and jobs progressing smoothly.

Role Overview: We are looking for an experienced Estimator to take ownership of the end-to-end quoting process for kitchen and joinery projects. You will work from joinery plans and drawings to calculate lineal metres, price materials, colours, hardware and installation, and produce accurate quotes ready for the client. The business will provide its templates, price lists and methodology, so you will have a clear framework to work within from day one. This is a role for someone who reads the detail properly, works through a set of drawings methodically, and takes pride in a quote that holds up. Accuracy here directly protects the margin on every job the business wins.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Reviewing joinery plans and drawings, including cabinet details, dimensions, finishes and colour selections
  • Calculating lineal metres and quantities from supplied drawings
  • Pricing colours and finishes using the supplied price lists
  • Pricing hardware and componentry
  • Pricing installation for each job
  • Preparing a full material and finishes schedule for each project
  • Producing complete, itemised quotes end-to-end using the business's templates
  • Raising any gaps or inconsistencies in drawings early so pricing stays accurate
  • Keeping quoting records and pricing information organised and up to date

Requirements

  • 2–3+ years of proven estimating experience in kitchens, cabinetry, or joinery manufacturing
  • Confident reading and interpreting joinery drawings and shop plans, including measurements and detailing
  • Strong numeracy skills and a methodical approach to takeoffs and quantities
  • Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to work through every detail on a drawing before pricing
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Word
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Self-managed working style, with the ability to own a process and deliver without close supervision
  • Reliable internet connection and own computer setup

Preferred/Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience with Cabinet Vision or similar cabinetry design and estimating software
  • Previous experience supporting Australian joinery, cabinetry, or building businesses

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

raw.description:
QA & Training Supervisor (Bilingual – English/Spanish) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (CST)
Language Requirement: Fluent English & Spanish

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a QA & Training Supervisor to lead quality assurance, coaching, training, and performance development across their Patient Concierge team.

This is not a passive call-monitoring role. You’ll take direct ownership of improving agent performance, communication quality, onboarding effectiveness, and overall customer experience.

The ideal candidate has experience in high-volume customer service environments, knows how to evaluate calls objectively, and can turn performance gaps into actionable coaching and measurable improvement.

What You’ll Own

Quality Assurance & Performance Monitoring

  • Review and evaluate agent calls and customer interactions.
  • Assess performance against established:
    • Service standards
    • Communication expectations
    • QA benchmarks
    • Customer experience standards
  • Maintain consistent QA scoring and evaluation processes.
  • Identify recurring performance issues, communication gaps, and coaching opportunities.
  • Ensure quality standards are applied consistently across the team.

Coaching & Performance Development

  • Conduct structured one-on-one coaching sessions with agents.
  • Deliver clear, actionable, and performance-focused feedback.
  • Coach agents on:
    • Communication
    • Confidence
    • Professionalism
    • Call handling
    • Consistency
  • Create improvement plans where necessary.
  • Track progress and ensure coaching translates into measurable performance improvements.

Training & New-Hire Onboarding

  • Own training and onboarding programs for new Patient Concierge team members.
  • Develop and continuously improve:
    • SOPs
    • Training materials
    • QA documentation
    • Learning paths
    • Coaching resources
  • Help new hires ramp quickly and confidently.
  • Identify onboarding gaps and improve training based on actual agent performance.

Reporting & Performance Insights

  • Prepare regular:
    • QA reports
    • Coaching summaries
    • Trend analyses
    • Performance dashboards
  • Track QA scores, training effectiveness, and agent improvement over time.
  • Identify patterns across the team and recommend corrective actions.
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into quality and performance trends.

QA & Training Operations

  • Manage QA review cycles independently.
  • Maintain organized coaching and training schedules.
  • Keep QA records and training documentation accurate and up to date.
  • Ensure consistent execution of quality, coaching, and training processes.
  • Collaborate with operations leadership to improve overall team performance.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience in one or more of the following:
    • Quality Assurance
    • Training
    • Coaching
    • Call Center Operations
    • Customer Service Leadership
  • Experience working in a high-volume customer service environment.
  • Fully bilingual in English and Spanish.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to provide constructive feedback and coach employees effectively.
  • Strong organizational, reporting, and documentation skills.
  • Comfortable holding team members accountable to performance standards.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment during CST hours.

Preferred Experience

  • Previous Supervisor, Team Lead, QA Lead, or Training Lead experience.
  • Experience in:
    • Healthcare
    • Patient services
    • Appointment scheduling
    • Concierge services
  • Familiarity with:
    • QA scorecards
    • Call-scoring frameworks
    • CRM platforms
    • Customer service KPIs
    • Coaching and performance improvement plans

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You have a strong ear for communication quality and quickly recognize performance gaps.
  • You enjoy coaching and helping people improve.
  • You balance accountability with constructive support.
  • You are highly organized and consistent in how you evaluate performance.
  • You remain calm and professional during difficult coaching or escalation conversations.
  • You take ownership without requiring constant oversight.
  • You care about building a quality-driven, high-performing service culture.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

  • Review recorded calls and score agent performance.
  • Conduct coaching and feedback sessions.
  • Analyze QA trends and identify recurring performance gaps.
  • Track agent progress following coaching.
  • Train and onboard new Patient Concierge team members.
  • Update SOPs, training materials, and QA documentation.
  • Prepare performance reports for leadership.
  • Collaborate with operations leaders on quality improvements.

In short: you ensure agents consistently deliver high-quality customer experiences while helping the team continuously improve.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Improvement in overall QA scores.
  • Increased consistency in customer service quality.
  • Measurable agent improvement following coaching.
  • Faster and more effective new-hire ramp-up.
  • Training completion and effectiveness.
  • Accurate and consistent QA evaluations.
  • Reduction in recurring communication and service issues.
  • Clear and reliable quality reporting for leadership.

Interview Process

Step 1: Initial Screening

  • Communication skills
  • QA and training experience
  • English and Spanish proficiency

Step 2: Client Interview

  • Coaching methodology
  • QA evaluation approach
  • Real-world performance scenarios

Step 3: Final Interview

  • Leadership and accountability style
  • Ownership and problem-solving
  • Team and operational alignment

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re bilingual in English and Spanish, have strong QA, training, or coaching experience, and enjoy developing high-performing customer service teams, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build a consistent, quality-focused Patient Concierge experience.
